# 3D Studio Video Creator

`/apps/3d-studio` · Video · live · shows as: hub tile (not in any `plugins.ts` list)

> Describe a video → an AI animation director makes it

An AI animation director that turns a short prompt into a complete animated video. Pick a style,
length and format; the director writes the story beats, casts characters, scouts sets and
storyboards every shot with a camera move, lighting and timing, and decides for each piece of motion
whether Mixamo, Cascadeur or Blender should animate it — and says why. The storyboard plays at once
as a moving 3D animatic you can export; one click sends it to Blender on the owner's PC, where
Claude Code builds, animates and renders the finished film to watch and download.

![3D Studio Video Creator](../../public/look/3d-studio.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Direct a video** (`src/components/studio3d/Studio3D.tsx`)

- **Prompt box** — "Describe a video. The director makes it."; Ctrl/⌘+Enter submits. `Studio3D.tsx`
- **Six styles as swatch cards** — Stylized 3D, Anime toon, Claymation, Low poly, Cinematic, Paper craft; each sets a Blender look and engine (EEVEE/CYCLES) and an animatic palette. `src/lib/studio3d/types.ts` (`STYLES`)
- **Length** 15 s · 30 s · 1 min · 2 min and **Format** 16:9 Wide · 9:16 Vertical · 1:1 Square. `Studio3D.tsx` (`Segmented`), `types.ts` (`LENGTHS`, `ASPECTS`)
- **Mood & audience** — optional fields behind a toggle. `Studio3D.tsx`
- **"Try one" examples** and **"The crew"** card listing the tools and their roles. `Studio3D.tsx`, `src/lib/studio3d/tools/registry.ts`
- **"The director is planning your video" overlay** — clapperboard animation and seven ticking steps (Reading your prompt … Timing every scene). `Studio3D.tsx` (`DIRECTING`)
- **AI director with an offline fallback** — uses the hub AI provider when a key is set, otherwise a built-in heuristic director; the plan says which ("AI director" / "Offline director"). `src/lib/studio3d/director/index.ts`, `director/llm.ts`, `director/heuristic.ts`, `director/normalize.ts`

**Your videos**

- **Gallery** — first look-dev still or a sky/ground poster, status pill, title, length, logline, tool chips, "N scenes · aspect · style", time ago; polls every 5 s while rendering, 20 s otherwise. `Studio3D.tsx` (`ProjectCard`)
- **Filters** — All · Storyboards · In production · Rendered, with counts. `Studio3D.tsx`

**One video** (`/apps/3d-studio/<id>`, `src/components/studio3d/ProjectPage.tsx`)

- **Pipeline strip** — Interpret · Storyboard · Tool plan · Build & animate · Render · Preview & export, with done/active states. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`STEPS`)
- **Screening room** — switch Final render ↔ Animatic; the final video plays with **Download video** and a line of resolution · fps · engine · size. `ProjectPage.tsx`
- **3D animatic** — the plan played as moving Three.js previz (sets, stand-in rigs, camera moves, title card, scene tag, narration subtitles, fades); play/pause, scrub bar, jump by scene. `src/components/studio3d/Animatic.tsx`, `src/lib/studio3d/animatic/engine.ts`
- **Export animatic** — records the canvas to WebM (or MP4) in the browser, then "Download". `Animatic.tsx`
- **Next-action bar** — Render in Blender / Render again / Try again; while queued "Take out of queue"; live note while the PC works. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`ActionBar`)
- **Storyboard tab** — scene cards with frame, title, summary, camera, duration and per-action tool chips; click a frame to play from that scene. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`Storyboard`)
- **Edit a scene** — title, what happens, narration, camera move (static, dolly in/out, orbit, pan, crane up, tracking, handheld), seconds. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`SceneEditor`), `PATCH src/app/api/studio3d/projects/[id]/route.ts`
- **Re-route motion** — click a tool chip to hand that motion to a different tool; scene lengths rebalance to keep the total length. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`cycleTool`)
- **"Give the director a note" → Another take** — re-plans the whole storyboard with your note. `ProjectPage.tsx`, `projects/[id]/route.ts` (`redirect`)
- **Storyboard locks while rendering**. `src/lib/studio3d/reducer.ts` (`canEdit`)
- **Production tab** — look-dev frames from Blender, render report (incl. "Changed or left out"), live production log. `ProjectPage.tsx` (`Production`)
- **Director's read** — logline, genre, tone, audience, length, pacing, look, music, sound. `ProjectPage.tsx`
- **Tool plan** — which tools this video uses and why, whether the PC is ready (Blender installed, Mixamo clips missing, Cascadeur or Blender fallback); planned tools shown greyed. `src/components/studio3d/ToolPlan.tsx`
- **Cast and Sets** lists. `ProjectPage.tsx`
- **Delete project** — confirms; files on the PC are kept. `ProjectPage.tsx`

**Connect your studio PC** (`src/components/studio3d/StudioSetup.tsx`)

- **Status + what the PC has** — Blender (version), Blender MCP, Mixamo library clip count, Cascadeur (+ MCP). `StudioSetup.tsx`
- **Setup steps** — studio token (shown once), `.env` lines incl. optional `BLENDER_PATH`, install commands (`winget` Blender + uv, `claude mcp add blender`), start command. `StudioSetup.tsx`, `src/app/api/studio3d/builder-token/route.ts`

**On the PC** (`tools/studio3d-builder/`, not deployed)

- **Studio builder** — claims queued videos, writes `job.json`, runs Claude Code with the `animation-director` skill, streams progress, look-dev stills and the final render back; one at a time. `npm run doctor` shows what the PC has. `tools/studio3d-builder/builder.mjs`, `lib/detect.mjs`, `lib/claude.mjs`, `lib/watch.mjs`
- **Large uploads in ≤ 8 MB chunks** (Next keeps only 10 MB of a body that passes through middleware). `src/app/api/studio3d/builder/media/route.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** DESIGN.md instrument panel with a film-studio accent; no design-skill record found.
- **Colours / type:** hub Tailwind tokens (`bg-panel`, `border-line`, `text-ink*`, indigo `bg-brand` buttons, cyan `text-accent` eyebrow). Tool chips have their own colours: Blender `#f5792a`, Mixamo `#ff3a7a`, Cascadeur `#7c5cff`, Animatic `#2dd4bf`, Voice `#60a5fa`, Music `#facc15`, Concept art `#f472b6`. Style swatches use each style's 3-colour palette. System sans; mono for durations and the log.
- **Layout:** laptop — hero splits form (left) and examples/crew (320 px right); gallery 4/3/2/1 columns; project page = main column + 380 px side column. Phone — everything stacks; pipeline strip scrolls sideways.
- **Signature pieces:** film-strip **sprocket** edge on the hero (`.s3d-sprockets`), brand+accent radial hero wash, sky/ground poster cards, clapperboard "directing" overlay, colour-dotted tool chips.
- **Motion:** clapper 1.1 s loop, active pipeline dot pulse, card hover lift; reduced motion stops the CSS animations (`studio3d.css`).

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/3d-studio/page.tsx` · `src/app/apps/3d-studio/[id]/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/studio3d/` |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/studio3d/` (`types.ts`, `director/`, `animatic/engine.ts`, `tools/registry.ts`, `reducer.ts`, `store.ts`, `studio3d.test.ts`) |
| API | `src/app/api/studio3d/` — `projects`, `projects/[id]`, `media/[id]/[which]`, `builder-token`, `builder/{claim,progress,media,fail}` (token-auth, session-exempt in `src/middleware.ts`) |
| Saved data | `server_docs` row `studio3d` · Storage bucket `studio3d-media` (stills + final video) |
| PC helper | `tools/studio3d-builder/` (skill at `~/.claude/skills/animation-director`, override `STUDIO3D_SKILL_DIR`) |

## Owner's rules for this app

- The website never runs Blender: it keeps the record, shows the storyboard and plays an in-browser animatic so there is always something to preview and export.
- You review the storyboard before anything renders.
- Every production tool is declared once in `src/lib/studio3d/tools/registry.ts`; adding a tool (voice, music, concept art are reserved slots) is one entry there plus a reference file in the `animation-director` skill.
- Mixamo for everyday humanoid motion, Cascadeur for stunts/fights/creatures/physics, Blender for cameras, objects and effects — each choice comes with a reason.

- None found.

# AI Rankings

`/apps/ai-rankings` · AI · live · shows as: App plugins card (Jarvis › App plugins; `PLUGIN_SLUGS` in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`, so no hub tile)

> Your tool database

A private database of every tool worth remembering — AI models first, but also editors, design
apps, media tools, security and trading software. For each tool it keeps what it costs, whether it
is open source / runs on your own machine, and whether it needs an API key, plus your own notes and
a list of features marked love / good / missing / dealbreaker that explain why it holds its rank.
It reads like a database on purpose: sections down the left, a sortable table in the middle, the
full record on the right.

![AI Rankings](../../public/look/ai-rankings.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The board (three panes)**

- **Section tree** — groups › categories (AI, Dev, Design, Productivity, Media, Security, Trading to start) with a record count on each; add a new group or category in place, and it stays even while empty. `src/components/ai-rankings/Sidebar.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/seed.ts` (`SEED_TREE`), `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`addGroup`, `addCategory`)
- **Starts empty** — a new board has the sections and no records (owner's own list, not someone else's 95 picks). `src/lib/ai-rankings/seed.ts`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`buildSeed`)
- **Saved views** — one click for All records, Ranked, Unranked, Open source, Free, Self-hostable, Needs a key, Key in hand, Has a love note. `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`VIEWS`), `Sidebar.tsx`
- **Content filter All / Safe / 18+** — Safe hides records rated suggestive or uncensored (unrated stay visible); 18+ shows only those. It runs before everything else, so hidden records can't leak through counts, search or select-all; shows "(N hidden)". Remembered per device, never synced, and survives "reset". `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`CONTENT_FILTERS`, `applyContentFilter`), `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`CONTENT_FILTER_KEY`), `src/components/ai-rankings/AiRankings.tsx`
- **"Added" window** — Any time, 7 days, 30 days, 3 months, 1 year, or Between two dates; picking one switches the sort to Newest. `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`ADDED_PRESETS`), `Sidebar.tsx`, `AiRankings.tsx`
- **Features index** — every feature written on the records in view, with counts (top 12, "+N more"); click one to show only tools that do it. `Sidebar.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`featureIndex`)
- **Search** names, notes and features from the top bar. `src/components/ai-rankings/AiRankings.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`filterTools`)
- **Tag filter** — click a tag on a record to filter by it (stackable). `src/components/ai-rankings/AiRankings.tsx` (`onTag`), `src/components/ai-rankings/chips.tsx` (`TagPill`)
- **Status strip** — where you are, active filters, "shown/total", a reset link, and "drag rows to rank" when one category is open. `src/components/ai-rankings/AiRankings.tsx`
- **Sortable table** — columns Name, Section, Cost (free green / free tier amber / paid red), Source (open/closed), Runs (web / local / web+local), Rank, Added; click a header to sort, again to flip. `src/components/ai-rankings/ToolTable.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/query.ts` (`sortTools`)
- **NEW badge and ★ love count** on rows — NEW for records added in the last 30 days; ★ shows how many "Why I keep it" features a tool has; 18+/soft badge for adult-rated tools. `src/components/ai-rankings/ToolTable.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/types.ts` (`isNew`, `NEW_DAYS`), `chips.tsx` (`ContentBadge`)

**Ranking**

- **A leaderboard per category** — rank a tool, move it up/down with arrows from any view (within its own category), or unrank it. `src/components/ai-rankings/ToolTable.tsx`, `src/components/ai-rankings/DetailPanel.tsx` (`RankRow`), `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`rankTool`, `moveToPosition`, `unrankTool`)
- **Drag rows to rank** when a single category is open. `src/components/ai-rankings/ToolTable.tsx` (`draggable`, `drop`)

**The record panel**

- **Edit every field in place** — name, link (with open-in-new-tab), filed under group › category, what it is, cost to you (Free / Free tier / Paid), where it runs (Website / Self-host / Both), API key (Required / Optional / None), Open source toggle, "I have the key" toggle, pricing note, notes, tags. `src/components/ai-rankings/DetailPanel.tsx`
- **Content rating** per record — Unrated / Filtered / Suggestive / Uncensored. `DetailPanel.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/types.ts` (`ContentRating`, `CONTENT_LABEL`)
- **Features & verdicts** — add notes marked ★ Why I keep it / + Good / − Missing / ✕ Dealbreaker; click a verdict to change it; remove one. "The case for its rank." `DetailPanel.tsx`, `chips.tsx` (`VERDICT_STYLE`), `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`addFeature`, `updateFeature`, `deleteFeature`)
- **Date stamp** — every record keeps when you added it (`addedAt`) and last changed it. `src/lib/ai-rankings/types.ts`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts`
- **Auto-file this** — reads the tool and proposes section, summary, tags, cost, openness, hosting, key, pricing, content rating and new features; you press **Apply filing** or **Discard**, and suggested features are chips you add one by one. With no AI key a keyword pass answers and says so. `DetailPanel.tsx` → `src/app/api/ai-rankings/classify/route.ts`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/classify.ts` (`heuristicSuggestion`, `coerceSuggestion`)
- **Delete a record** (two-press confirm). `DetailPanel.tsx`

**Adding and managing records**

- **New ▸ Analyze a link** — paste a URL and the whole entry is made: the page is read (blocked from private addresses), GitHub / Hugging Face / arXiv links are found (even ones a script-built page renders), their APIs give licence and stars, then it is filed like Auto-file and opened for review. The same link twice opens the existing record; a section name close to an existing one ("Images" vs "Image") reuses it. No AI key → offline heuristic entry. `src/components/ai-rankings/AnalyzeLink.tsx`, `AiRankings.tsx` (`addFromLink`) → `src/app/api/ai-rankings/analyze-url/route.ts`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/analyzeLink.ts`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/readSite.ts`
- **New ▸ Blank entry** — starts an "Untitled" record in the section you're viewing (rated Uncensored if you're in the 18+ view). `AiRankings.tsx` (`addRecord`)
- **Select rows + Delete selected** — checkboxes per row and a select-all that only covers rows on screen; two-press confirm. `AiRankings.tsx`, `ToolTable.tsx`
- **Clear all records** — keeps your sections and colours; the armed button disarms itself after 5 s. `AiRankings.tsx` (`clearAll`), `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`clearTools`)
- **Export / Import JSON** — download `ai-rankings-<date>.json`; importing replaces the board. `AiRankings.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`exportJson`, `importJson`)
- **Follows you between devices** — local-first in localStorage, synced through `app_state` (key `ai-rankings:v2`). `src/lib/ai-rankings/store.ts` (`saveSynced`), `AiRankings.tsx` (`useRemotePull`)

**Feeding the board from elsewhere in Jarvis**

- **"AI Rankings" folder → Sync button on each entry** — in Jarvis › Folders, any folder whose name contains "ai ranking(s)" (e.g. "ai rankings folder") and its sub-folders gets a Sync button per entry; pressing it files that one entry on the board, auto-categorised from its name/link/summary. Already-filed entries show a green chip naming the section, which opens the app. Nothing syncs by itself. `src/components/recall/RankingsSync.tsx`, `src/components/recall/FolderWorkspace.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/fromDashboard.ts` (`isRankingsName`, `inRankingsFolder`, `findOnBoard`, `syncToRankings`)
- **A link found from the name** — in that folder, a website saved with no URL gets one: the AI names the official site; with no key (or an unknown name) the server tries `<name>.com/.ai/.io/.app/.dev` and keeps the first that answers; otherwise a flagged `.com` guess. Always an editable suggestion. `src/components/recall/WebsitesSection.tsx`, `src/components/recall/rankingsFolder.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/siteUrl.ts` → `src/app/api/ai-rankings/site-url/route.ts`
- **"Find links for N entries"** — the folder header fills in links for every old linkless entry (folder + sub-folders), 3 at a time, never overwriting a typed link. `src/components/recall/FolderWorkspace.tsx`, `src/lib/ai-rankings/backfillUrls.ts`
- **Add a model from Jarvis › Toolbox › Armory › Models** — each model row has a button to file it on the board, or a green check (opens AI Rankings) if it's already there. `src/components/jarvis/ToolsTab.tsx` (`addToBoard` → `fileOnBoard`), mounted by `src/components/new-jarvis/ArmoryTab.tsx`

## How it looks

- **Look:** the hub's "Night Console" dark database chrome (see `DESIGN.md`); built as a dense three-pane database rather than a card grid (change log 2026-08-31). No app-specific design skill recorded.
- **Colours / type:** hub tokens — `bg-canvas` `#0a0b0f`, `bg-panel` `#12141c`, `bg-panel-2` `#181b25`, `bg-elevated` `#1d212d`, borders `line` `#262a38` / `line-soft` `#1e222e`, text `ink` `#e9ecf3` / `ink-muted` `#9aa3b5` / `ink-faint` `#6b7385`, accent `brand` `#6366f1`. Each group has its own hue (`GROUP_HUE` in `src/lib/ai-rankings/types.ts`: AI 265, Dev 200, Design 305, Productivity 155, Media 25, Security 350, Trading 45; invented groups get a stable hashed hue) used in the sidebar, rank badges and the record's colour stripe. State colours: emerald = free/open/love, amber = free tier/missing/soft, rose = paid/dealbreaker/18+, sky = good. System sans for text at 13px; JetBrains Mono for column headers, counts, status strip and badges (uppercase, wide tracking).
- **Layout:** laptop (`lg`+) — fixed-height app: top bar (Hub link, title, search, export/import/clear, New menu), 240px section sidebar, table filling the middle, 380px record panel on the right when a record is open. Phone — the sidebar is hidden behind a menu button and slides over as an overlay; the record panel opens full screen; the table drops columns by width (Section below `md`, Cost below `sm`, Source/Runs below `lg`, Added below `xl`) and export/import/clear are hidden below `sm`. Inside Jarvis (`embedded`) the Hub link is hidden and the height fits under Jarvis's header.
- **Signature pieces:** the dense table with sticky header and per-section rank badges, the coloured group stripe on the record panel, verdict pills (★ + − ✕), the 18+/soft content badge, the All/Safe/18+ switch, the green "on the board" chip in the Folders view.
- **Motion:** almost none — `animate-fade-in` on the New menu and flash messages, colour transitions on hover. Nothing to reduce.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/ai-rankings/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/ai-rankings/` (`AiRankings.tsx`, `Sidebar.tsx`, `ToolTable.tsx`, `DetailPanel.tsx`, `AnalyzeLink.tsx`, `chips.tsx`) · folder hooks in `src/components/recall/` (`RankingsSync.tsx`, `rankingsFolder.tsx`, `FolderWorkspace.tsx`, `WebsitesSection.tsx`) · `src/components/jarvis/ToolsTab.tsx` |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/ai-rankings/` (`store.ts`, `query.ts`, `types.ts`, `seed.ts`, `classify.ts`, `analyzeLink.ts`, `readSite.ts`, `siteUrl.ts`, `fromDashboard.ts`, `backfillUrls.ts`; tests `analyzeLink`, `backfillUrls`, `fromDashboard`, `nulkey`, `siteUrl`) |
| API | `src/app/api/ai-rankings/` (`classify`, `analyze-url`, `site-url`) — all use `src/lib/ai/provider.ts` with an offline fallback |
| Saved data | localStorage + `app_state` synced key `ai-rankings:v2` · per-device (not synced) `ai-rankings:content-filter` |

## Owner's rules for this app

- Cost, open source, hosting and content rating are **separate axes** — never collapse them into one field.
- An unrated record is "not checked", never "safe": Safe mode keeps unrated records visible, and the classifier leaves the rating "unknown" unless something says otherwise.
- The Safe/18+ filter describes the screen, not the data — it stays per device and is never synced; "reset" never turns it off.
- Filing is a suggestion you accept (Auto-file → Apply/Discard). Analyze a link writes the entry straight onto the board but opens it for review.
- The AI Rankings folder is a scratchpad: nothing goes to the board until Sync is pressed on that entry. "Already on the board" is worked out by name/link match, never stored on the folder item.
- Facts read from GitHub / Hugging Face (licence, stars) beat what the model says.
- Must work with no AI key (keyword fallback everywhere).

## Described but not found in code

- **"Seeded with ~95 real tools"** — catalog overview (`src/lib/catalog.ts`). The board now starts with sections and no records (`src/lib/ai-rankings/seed.ts`, change log 2026-09-06 "start it empty"); the catalog text is out of date.
- **AI Rankings as a tab in Jarvis's Toolbox** — change log 2026-09-21 ("Toolbox folds open in the rail to Skills, Tools and AI Rankings"). Today's Toolbox (`src/components/new-jarvis/NewJarvis.tsx` `GROUPS`) has no AI Rankings tab; `AiRankings` still accepts an `embedded` prop but nothing mounts it. It is reached as an App plugins card instead.

# App Builder

`/apps/app-builder` · AI · live · shows as: App plugins card

> Idea or screen recording → a commercial-grade app

Where every new app starts. The owner types an idea or drops a screen recording / screenshots of an
app or workflow; a "super agent" takes it apart, asks what the app is for, proposes features to
accept or deny, then hands the build to Claude Code with the owner's skill pipeline. It is also the
one home for building: a switcher holds **Build** (App Builder) and **Website Redesigner**
(see `docs/apps/website-redesigner.md`). Jarvis chat, Camera Autopilot and Client Review all send work here.

![App Builder](../../public/look/app-builder.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The home**
- **Build / Website Redesigner switcher** — StudioHome tabs, `?section=build|redesign`, last section remembered (`app-builder:section`). `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilderHome.tsx`, `src/lib/studio-home/builder.ts`
- **Framed inside Jarvis shows Build alone, no bar** (`framedSection="build"`). `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilderHome.tsx`
- **`/apps/website-redesigner` redirects in** keeping `?v=2` / `?v=showcase`. `src/app/apps/website-redesigner/page.tsx`

**1. The idea**
- **Idea box** — one line or a full brief, example chips, the backdrop Orbit charges up as you type. `src/components/app-builder/Stages.tsx` (`IdeaStage`)
- **Attach recordings and pictures** — paperclip, drag-and-drop or paste; videos read in the browser into evenly spaced frames + first 60 s of narration, kept under ~4.5 MB. `src/components/app-builder/Composer.tsx`, `src/lib/app-builder/media.ts`
- **`?idea=` prefill** — Website Redesigner › Showcase › "Use this idea" opens Build with the idea filled in. `src/components/app-builder/Stages.tsx`, `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilder.tsx`
- **Hand-offs wake up here** — projects from Jarvis chat / Camera Autopilot arrive `pending` with "From Jarvis chat" / "From Camera Autopilot" and a "Start the super agent" button; their media waits in IndexedDB. `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilder.tsx`, `src/lib/app-builder/fromChat.ts`, `src/lib/app-builder/inbox.ts`

**2. The purpose**
- **Recording teardown** — the agent watches frames + narration (`watch`) and shows screens, flow, behaviour, data. `src/components/app-builder/Blueprint.tsx` (`Recording`), `src/app/api/app-builder/route.ts`
- **Interview** — "What is it for?" questions with suggested answers (pick any, skip any), then "Design my features". `src/components/app-builder/Stages.tsx` (`Interview`)

**3. The features**
- **The Orbit** — features are bodies on a ring: drag into the core to accept (green), fling out to deny (red), tap to select; core ignites when all are decided. `src/components/app-builder/Orbit.tsx`
- **Feature table** — accept / deny / edit wording, "Add your own feature" (accepted as written), "edited" and "yours" marks. `src/components/app-builder/FeatureTable.tsx`
- **Agent chat** — typed commands work offline ("accept 1, 3", "deny the rest", "edit 2 to …", "accept all", help) via `parseCommand`; chips like "What would make people pay for this?"; client edits get their own chips. `src/components/app-builder/AgentChat.tsx`, `src/lib/app-builder/engine.ts`
- **Tally + top-bar Build it** — "in · open · out" count; once handed off the button becomes the live build phase. `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilder.tsx`
- **Project picker** — "＋ New app", every project tagged "from chat", "from camera" or "vN client edit"; delete with confirm. `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilder.tsx`
- **Phone panes** — Features / Agent / Build tabs replace the side panel on small screens. `src/components/app-builder/AppBuilder.tsx`

# Baby No Scroll

`/apps/baby-no-scroll` · Apps · live · shows as: App plugins card

> Hand over the screen, not the device

A child lock for a phone or tablet you are about to put in a small pair of hands. A parent picks one
YouTube video or playlist, or one of four baby games, presses **Hand it over**, and that one thing
fills the screen with everything else taken away. The only way out is a padlock that has to be
dragged the whole length of the screen and held — a gesture a baby cannot make by accident.

![Baby No Scroll](../../public/look/baby-no-scroll.jpg)

- **Saved shows list** — everything ever put on is kept, most recent first, one tap to pick again, **Forget** to remove; the same link is never saved twice (it is renamed/bumped instead). `src/lib/baby-no-scroll/store.ts` (`upsertShow`, `sortedShows`, `removeShow`)

**The locked screen (the "nursery")**
- **Everything taken away** — no scrolling, bounce, pull-to-refresh, pinch or double-tap zoom, text selection, long-press menus, image drag, back gesture (a sentinel history entry swallows it) or keyboard. `src/lib/baby-no-scroll/useScreenLock.ts`

- **Drag the full rail, then hold on the latch → shackle pops open**; a filling ring shows the hold. `Padlock.tsx`, `lock.ts` (`UNLOCK_AT` = 94 %)

- **Hide and seek** (from 14 months) — six eggs, a shape (star, heart, flower, moon, fish, bird) under one; every egg cracks and gives something back, the prize egg is just louder. `src/components/baby-no-scroll/games/Eggs.tsx`

- **Look:** two deliberately opposite worlds in one sheet — the parent's console (the hub's dark instrument panel) and the child's nursery (warm, huge soft shapes, no text). No `.impeccable/surfaces/` record; design skill not recorded.
- **Colours / type:** console uses DESIGN.md tokens unchanged (`bg-canvas`, `bg-panel`, `text-ink*`, `border-line`, `text-core` green tick, `amber-400` for "on"/warnings). # Contradicting

`/apps/contradicting` · AI · live · shows as: App plugins card (Jarvis › App plugins, opens in its own tab)

> Receipts for “I never said that”

A clip-on recorder (the Omi pendant, or the Omi app on your phone) streams what was said, and Contradicting keeps each
person's words with the exact time. When someone says "I never called you that", it finds the line where they did and
answers on your phone ("Actually, at 3:47 PM… you did say…") with a replay of the lead-up. Consent-first and fair:
only people who agreed are recorded, and everyone — you included — is checked the same way.

![Contradicting](../../public/look/contradicting.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Catching contradictions**

- **Same meaning in different words, with Claude** — when no word match is found, the AI reads that person's own earlier lines and may only point at a line that is really in the record (never invents a quote). `src/lib/contradicting/server/ai.ts` (via `src/lib/ai/provider.ts`)

## How it looks

- **Look:** "evidence-room HUD" from an interactive-web-studio pass — every conversation is a reel of tape; one signature moment (the stamp), everything else quiet and dense so it reads mid-argument on a phone. Does **not** use DESIGN.md's tokens; own variables on `.cx-root`.
- **Colours / type:** ink black `#07080b` with a faint amber radial glow, panels `#0e1016` / `#141720`, line `#232838`, text `#eceef4`, muted `#8d93a6`, **amber `#ffb547` for the record**, **red `#ff4d5e` for the denial**, each person in their own hue (`hsl(<hue> 85% 60%)`). Fixed film grain overlay. Fonts: Oxanium (500–800) display + JetBrains Mono, loaded in `page.tsx` as `--font-nj-display` / `--font-nj-mono`; body is system sans. Theme colour `#07080b`.
- **Layout:** one centred column (max 760px) on laptop and phone; the Replay is a bottom sheet on phone and a centred rounded sheet from 760px.
- **Signature pieces:** the spinning tape-reel logo, the red→amber thread on each receipt, the stamp, the fairness bar.
- **Motion:** stamp + shake, scan, entry (`cx-in`), sheet up (`cx-up`), reel spin; all off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Owner's rules for this app

- **Consent-first:** a line is kept only for a person who agreed; withdrawing deletes everything they said; voices nobody named are dropped after 48 hours (`LIMITS.unnamedHours`).
- **Fair:** every consenting person is checked the same way — the owner too.
- The AI may only point at a line that is really in the record — never generate a quote.

# Cook Connect

`/apps/cook-connect` · Apps · live · shows as: App plugins card (Jarvis › App plugins, `PLUGIN_SLUGS` in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`) — also starred by default on every account's Jarvis Dashboard (`DEFAULT_FAVORITES` in `src/lib/new-jarvis/launcher.ts`)

> Cook together, then play each other

Two apps in one account: **Cookbook** (publish and save cookbooks, write recipes from a link, photo, video or a sentence, keep a food journal, join cooking groups) and **Connect** (spades and chess against people or computer players, with chat and video at the table). One profile, one follow graph and one feed system cover both halves. It replaced Cookbook Genie and Pod Play Connect (merged Sep 2026) and runs on its own Supabase `cook` schema, or entirely in the browser with no keys.

![Cook Connect](../../public/look/cook-connect.jpg)

## Owner's rules for this app

# Custom Video Swap

`/apps/custom-video-swap` · Video · live · shows as: App plugins card (in `PLUGIN_SLUGS`, not on the Studio wall) + a Studio card in Jarvis › Studio on the "Special skills" shelf (`WORKFLOWS` in `src/lib/studio/workflows.ts`)

> New characters, a new world, the original motion

Recast any clip. You drop the driving video, a face photo for each new character and a background
picture; each person in the clip sits next to who they become with an arrow between, you tap them
on the frame where faces are clearest, and the new world sits beside them. **Make it** sends the job
— clip included — to the owner's PC, where Viggle swaps the characters, MiniMax H3 turns the
background picture into a living plate and Robust Video Matting lays the people onto it. It comes
back as a before | after you drag across. Free, on the owner's own GPU.

![Custom Video Swap](../../public/look/custom-video-swap.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Ways in**
- **Studio card** — pick "Custom Video Swap" in Jarvis › Studio (Special skills), drop the clip + face photos (+ a background picture) and type who becomes who in the composer, or name `@custom-video-swap` in the Studio chat; the screen opens with every upload already in its slot. `src/components/jarvis/StudioTab.tsx`, `src/components/jarvis/ChatTab.tsx` (`FLOW_SCREENS`), `src/lib/studio/video-swap/useVideoSwap.ts` (`startFromSeed`)
- **Uploads placed for you** — first clip = driving video; pictures = new characters in order; the LAST picture = background when the line mentions a background (the only picture, when the line is only about the background). `src/lib/studio/video-swap/plan.ts` (`placeUploads`)
- **Your words read** — the line sets the scene description, "keep the background", shape (vertical/TikTok → 9:16, YouTube → 16:9, square), quality (HD / draft) and camera (still, push in, drift). `src/lib/studio/video-swap/plan.ts` (`readPrompt`, `draftFromPrompt`)

## How it looks

- **Look:** taste-skill "Cold Luxury" (design read at the top of `video-swap.css`: dials variance 7 · motion 6 · density 3) — the shared look for premium Studio flows; Workflow Maker reuses it. Not DESIGN.md; every rule is scoped under `.vs`.

## Owner's rules for this app

## Owner's rules for this app

- **Keep the `recall` names.** Storage keys, module paths, `/api/recall/*` and the `recall_auth` / `recall_member` cookies stay as they are — renaming orphans every saved note and breaks invite links family already hold. Only the page moved.

# Dump Finder

`/apps/dump-finder` · Utilities · live · shows as: App plugins card

> Where this load can go, and how far it is

A map for whoever is standing next to a loaded truck. It finds the phone, draws a ring of the chosen
radius (1–50 miles) and pins every asphalt plant / paving yard, concrete and rubble yard, landfill,
transfer station, recycling center and scrap yard inside it, nearest first — with the driver's own
notes (price a ton, gate hours, "taking millings this week?") kept on each site.

![Dump Finder](../../public/look/dump-finder.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Where you are searching from**
- **Finds the phone on open** — asks for location once; a saved last place shows straight away and a GPS fix replaces it. `src/components/dump-finder/DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Use my location** button with plain-English errors when the browser can't share location. `DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Type a ZIP, town or job-site address instead** — up to 5 matches (US and Canada) to pick from; "Nothing matched. Try a ZIP." `DumpFinder.tsx`, `src/app/api/dump-finder/geocode/route.ts` (OpenStreetMap Nominatim, no key)
- **Search this area** — drag the map away and a button appears to search around the map's centre. `DumpFinder.tsx` (`searchHere`), `src/components/dump-finder/MapView.tsx`
- **"Searching from" readout** with the place name and a status light (Locating / Searching / ready / error). `DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Remembers where you left it** — last place, radius, filters and map style reopen as they were. `src/lib/dump-finder/store.ts`

**Radius and filters**
- **Radius slider 1–50 mi** with a mono readout, plus quick buttons **5 / 10 / 25 / 50 mi** (default 25). `DumpFinder.tsx`, `store.ts` (`RADIUS_STOPS`)
- **Six kind filter chips** — Asphalt & millings (A), Concrete & C&D (C), Landfills (L), Transfer stations (T), Recycling centers (R), Scrap yards (S); each with its colour, letter, live count, and a tooltip of what it takes. `src/lib/dump-finder/kinds.ts`, `DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Double-click a chip to show only that kind**; an **All / None** switch toggles every kind. `DumpFinder.tsx` (`onlyKind`)

**The map**
- **Leaflet map with the radius drawn as a dashed survey ring**, auto-fitted to the ring; zoom control and an imperial-only scale bar. `MapView.tsx`
- **Map / Satellite switch** — OpenStreetMap streets or Esri World Imagery (to see whether a plant has a pile and a way in for a tri-axle). `MapView.tsx`, `DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Lettered, coloured pins** so they read in sunlight and for colour-blind eyes; a "+N" badge when a site is more than one kind; your own spots have a dashed white border; the selected pin grows. `MapView.tsx` (`pinHtml`), `src/components/dump-finder/dump-finder.css`
- **"You are here" dot** — solid pulsing blue for GPS, hollow for a typed place. `MapView.tsx`, `dump-finder.css`
- **Tap a pin → its row opens and scrolls into view**; picking a row pans the map to it when it is off-screen. `MapView.tsx`, `DumpFinder.tsx`

**The site list**
- **Every site inside the radius, nearest first**, with name, kinds and distance in miles; closed / disused / capped sites are left out; a plant mapped twice shows once. `src/lib/dump-finder/sites.ts` (`classify`, `toSites`)
- **Site detail** — address, operator, hours, phone (with Copy), fee ("Charges a fee" / "Free" / price), what it says it takes, and the exact point (with Copy). `DumpFinder.tsx`, `sites.ts` (`acceptedMaterials`)
- **Directions** button (opens Google Maps directions to the site), **Website** button, and **Fix on OpenStreetMap** link. `DumpFinder.tsx` (`directionsUrl`)
- **Notes box on every site** — "Takes millings? Price a ton, gate hours, who to ask for…"; saved per site and synced. `DumpFinder.tsx`, `store.ts` (`notes`)
- **Empty and error states in plain English** — no location yet, nothing within N mi ("Widen the radius, or add a spot you know"), nothing matching your filters, and an error with **Try again**. `DumpFinder.tsx`
- **Footer honesty note** — sites come from OpenStreetMap, call before you haul, many plants only take millings from account holders; plus "Updated <time>". `DumpFinder.tsx`

**Your own spots**
- **+ Add a spot** — "Tap the map where the spot is" banner (Cancel), then name it and pick its kinds (defaults to millings), Save spot / Discard. `DumpFinder.tsx`, `MapView.tsx`
- **Your spots appear with a "Your spot" tag**, mixed into the list by distance, and follow you to every device. `DumpFinder.tsx`, `store.ts` (`spots`)
- **Delete spot** with a "Delete this spot?" confirm. `DumpFinder.tsx`

**Behind the scenes**
- **Live sites from OpenStreetMap, no key** — Overpass query tried against three public mirrors in turn, with a 15-minute in-memory cache per ~1 km cell. `src/app/api/dump-finder/sites/route.ts`, `sites.ts` (`buildQuery`)

## How it looks

- **Look:** "the hub's instrument panel, bolted to a map" — follows DESIGN.md (near-black panels, colour only for state, mono for every number a driver reads). No `.impeccable/surfaces/` record; design skill not recorded.
- **Colours / type:** DESIGN.md tokens via CSS variables (`--color-canvas`, `--color-panel`, `--color-line`, `--color-ink*`, `--color-core` for ready, `#f59e0b` loading, `#ef4444` error, `--color-brand` focus ring). The only extra colour is the six kinds: millings `#f5b72b`, concrete `#38bdf8`, landfill `#e0703a`, transfer `#a78bfa`, recycling `#22c55e`, scrap `#b4bccb` (each with a dark ink colour for the letter). Search ring: dashed `#0a0b0f` stroke with a 6 % gold fill. Map tiles are left light on purpose (a dark-filtered map is hard to read in a cab at noon); map background `#d9d6cf`. Fonts: `--font-sans` body 13 px, title 18 px/650; `--font-mono` with tabular numbers for miles, coordinates, counts.
- **Layout:** full-screen fixed grid. Phone — map on top (min 260 px, 46 dvh), list as a sheet below, safe-area gutters. Laptop (≥ 900 px) — 400 px list rail on the left, map fills the right.
- **Signature pieces:** lettered colour pins, the dashed survey-line ring, the kind chips with live counts, the Map / Satellite segmented switch, the pulsing blue GPS dot.
- **Motion:** GPS dot ping, blinking status light while locating/loading, pin scale on hover/select, animated fit-to-ring. Reduced motion stops the ping and blink and the pin transition.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/dump-finder/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/dump-finder/` (`DumpFinder.tsx`, `MapView.tsx`, `dump-finder.css`) |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/dump-finder/` (`sites.ts` + `sites.test.ts`, `kinds.ts`, `store.ts`) |
| API | `src/app/api/dump-finder/sites/route.ts` (Overpass), `src/app/api/dump-finder/geocode/route.ts` (Nominatim) |
| Saved data | synced key `dump-finder:v1` (localStorage, synced through Supabase `app_state`; works local-only) — notes per site id (`osm:…` / `mine:…`), your spots, radius, kinds, map layer, last place |

## Owner's rules for this app

- **No API key needed** — sites and address search come from free OpenStreetMap services; keep it working with nothing set up.
- Every pin carries a **letter as well as a colour** (sunlight, colour-blind readers).
- **Map tiles stay light** — do not dark-filter the street map.

# EA Lab

`/apps/ea-lab` · Utilities · live · shows as: section of trading-studio (Trading Studio › EA Lab; `MERGED_INTO["ea-lab"] = "trading-studio"` in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`, so it is not a hub tile or an App plugins card)

> Test your trading bots

A bench where a MetaTrader Expert Advisor (a trading bot) stops being a claim and becomes a measurement. Drop a
bot in and a small runner on the PC/VPS installs it into a spare MetaTrader, backtests it with nobody touching the
terminal, files it by how it fails, and rates it on results it has not seen before. It reads like a database:
strategy list on the left, a sortable table in the middle, the full record on the right.

![EA Lab](../../public/look/ea-lab.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Getting bots in**

- **Upload EA** — button that takes `.ex4`, `.ex5`, `.mq4`, `.mq5`; shows "Working…" while busy. `src/components/ea-lab/EaLab.tsx`, `src/lib/ea-lab/client.ts` (`upload`)
- **Drag and drop anywhere** — dropping files on the page shows a "Drop to upload and test" overlay. `EaLab.tsx` (`dropProps`, `dragging`)
- **Drop folder (watched inbox)** — the left column shows the folder path (default `C:\EA-Lab\inbox`) and how many files are waiting; anything put there is taken in like an upload. `EaLab.tsx`, `tools/ea-lab-runner/server.mjs` (`INBOX`)
- **Scan inbox** — button to take the inbox in right now. `EaLab.tsx`, `client.ts` (`scan`)
- **Source is compiled first** — `.mq4`/`.mq5` are compiled with the chosen terminal's MetaEditor before each test; a compile error is shown in red on the record. `tools/ea-lab-runner/server.mjs`, `src/components/ea-lab/DetailPanel.tsx`

**The runner and test terminals**

- **Runner status light** — green "idle", amber "testing · N queued", "no test terminal", or red "runner not running", plus the machine name. `EaLab.tsx` (header)
- **Test terminals picker** — "Test terminals on <machine>": choose which spare MT4 and MT5 installs are used ("Test with this" / "testing with this"); opens by itself when none is chosen; MT4/MT5 badges in the header reopen it. `EaLab.tsx` (`RigPicker`), `client.ts` (`rigs`, `chooseRig`)
- **Runner-down help** — when the runner can't be reached, a plain panel explains it and lists the setup steps (copy `tools\ea-lab-runner`, run `install-autostart.cmd`, open `http://127.0.0.1:42030`). `EaLab.tsx` (`BridgeDown`)
- **Refreshes itself** — re-reads the runner every 15 seconds so tests finishing in the background show up. `EaLab.tsx`
- **Notices** — green/red one-line messages after an upload, scan or test request. `EaLab.tsx` (`notice`)

**The table**

- **Strategy tree** — All EAs, Trend, Mean reversion, Grid, Martingale, Hedge recovery, Scalper, News, Arbitrage, Panel / tool, Unfiled — each with a count; click to filter. `EaLab.tsx` (`STRATEGY_LABEL`)
- **Filter by name** — search box with a live row count. `EaLab.tsx`
- **Sortable columns** — Expert Advisor, Strategy, Rating, Max DD, **Naked**, Risk, Trades, Quality; default sort by rating, unrated last. `EaLab.tsx` (`COLS`, `rows`)
- **NAKED column** — peak *unhedged* exposure rebuilt from the open book, not from closed trades — the figure that actually ends accounts and no MetaTrader report prints. `src/lib/ea-lab/exposure.ts` (`analyzeExposure`)
- **Quality badge** — modelling quality rides with every number: untrusted / indicative / good / high fidelity. `src/lib/ea-lab/rating.ts` (`qualityTier`, `TIER_LABEL`)

**The record (right panel)**

- **Verdict first** — score coloured green ≥60, amber ≥35, red below, with the reasons; or "Not rated" with why. `DetailPanel.tsx`
- **Filed as** — the failure-mode family and how confident the filing is. `DetailPanel.tsx`, `src/lib/ea-lab/classify.ts` (`classify`)
- **Exposure** — base lot, largest multiple, gross peak, naked peak. `DetailPanel.tsx`
- **Runs** — every test with net profit, PF, drawdown and quality; profit factor deliberately last. `DetailPanel.tsx`
- **Test buttons** — Out-of-sample (the one the rating uses) and In-sample. `DetailPanel.tsx`, `client.ts` (`queueTest`)

**The rules that make the rating honest**

- **Out-of-sample only** — an EA with no out-of-sample run is not rated ("An in-sample backtest measures memory, not skill"); needs at least 30 closed trades; only the best quality tier available is used and "untrusted" (too-coarse) runs never count; an exposure penalty stops a martingale topping the table. `src/lib/ea-lab/rating.ts` (`rate`, `MIN_TRADES`)
- **Filed by how it fails** — martingale, hedge-recovery, grid, scalper, trend, mean-reversion…, read from the trades and exposure, not from which indicator it uses. `src/lib/ea-lab/classify.ts`
- **MT4 and MT5 report parsing** — Strategy Tester `.htm` reports from both platforms (encoding detected), with fixtures and tests. `src/lib/ea-lab/report.ts` (`parseReport`, `parseMt4Report`, `parseMt5Report`), `src/lib/ea-lab/__fixtures__/`

# EMBER Reveal

`/apps/fire-reveal` · Image · live · shows as: section of App Builder › Website Redesigner › Showcase (`MERGED_INTO` → `website-redesigner` → `app-builder`; played there in a frame)

> WebGL image reveal

A WebGL mouse-trail image-reveal studio with a custom GLSL shader, in the style of Unicorn Studio's
scanning effect. Two pixel-aligned images are stacked in one shader; moving the cursor paints a
trail that scans the top image away to reveal the hidden one underneath, with a thin chromatic-split
band at the edge. The trail holds for a beat after you stop, then eases closed. You can upload your
own two images, pick a reveal type and tune the brush live. It is now a reference piece in
Website Redesigner's Showcase.

![EMBER Reveal](../../public/look/fire-reveal.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

- **Mouse-trail reveal** — moving the pointer over the stage paints a persistent trail that reveals the hidden image, with chromatic split at the boundary; the trail fades after you stop. `src/components/reveal/RevealPlane.tsx`, `src/shaders/trailReveal.ts`, `src/components/reveal/FireRevealStudio.tsx`
- **Click to flash** — a click (or the panel's "⚡ Flash reveal" button) fires a burst reveal. `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`flash`, `burstRequest`)
- **Intro screen** — "Tear one image open to reveal what hides beneath.", a lede, a **Start creating** button; it also dismisses the moment you move onto the image. `FireRevealStudio.tsx`
- **Six reveal types, each with its own accent** — Trail `#ff6a1f`, Liquid `#5fe6ff`, Ripple `#4a90ff`, Glitch `#ff36c8`, Pixel `#7dff45`, Bulge `#a56bff`; the accent recolours the headline, buttons, sliders and brand slash. `src/shaders/trailReveal.ts` (`MODES`), `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`ControlPanel`)
- **Nine brush sliders (0–100%)** — Radius, Strength, Hardness, Tail, Fluidity, Dissipation, Chromatic ab., Momentum, Scale, each with a hover hint. `trailReveal.ts` (`PARAM_META`), `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`ParamSlider`)
- **Reset** — puts every slider back to its default. `FireRevealStudio.tsx`
- **Layers toolbar: upload your own images** — "↑ Base" and "↑ Hidden" file pickers (any image), plus **Demo wolf** to restore the bundled pair. `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`UploadButton`), `public/reveal/demo-base.png`, `public/reveal/demo-reveal.png`
- **Safe placeholders** — if an image fails to load, a generated "BASE" / "HIDDEN" gradient stands in. `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`makePlaceholder`)
- **On-stage hint** — "move to reveal · click to flash · drag to carve". `FireRevealStudio.tsx`
- **Reduced motion / no WebGL fallback** — a flat drag-to-reveal crossfade with a slider, and a note saying which case applies; reacts live if the reduced-motion setting changes. `FireRevealStudio.tsx` (`FlatFallback`)
- **Back link "← Hub"** and the **EMBER/MASK · WebGL Reveal Studio** wordmark. `FireRevealStudio.tsx`
- **Listed in Website Redesigner › Showcase** (view `?v=showcase`) — plays in place on the PlayShelf (poster note "WebGL — move the pointer over it once it loads"), "Open full screen", and **Use this idea** opens App Builder › Build with the idea box prefilled ("Build an app like EMBER Reveal: WebGL image reveal"). `src/lib/studio-home/builder.ts` (`SHOWCASE`, hue 22), `src/components/redesigner/Showcase.tsx`

## How it looks

- **Look:** a dark full-bleed "reveal studio" with film vignette and grain; styles are inline objects in `FireRevealStudio.tsx`. No design-skill record found.
- **Colours / type:** stage `#05060a`; panels `rgba(12,14,20,0.86)` with `var(--color-line)` borders; text from hub tokens (`--color-ink`, `--color-ink-muted`, `--color-ink-faint`); the one accent comes from the selected reveal type (Trail orange `#ff6a1f` by default; the fallback slider is always `#ff6a1f`). Headline 800 weight, `clamp(34px, 5.4vw, 72px)`, system sans; labels, hints and the wordmark in `ui-monospace`, uppercase, wide letter-spacing.
- **Layout:** full screen. Wordmark top-left, control panel a fixed 280 px column on the right (from 88 px down to 18 px from the bottom), Layers toolbar bottom-left, hint bottom-centre. There is no separate phone layout — the same panel overlays the image on a narrow screen.
- **Signature pieces:** the trail mask with chromatic rim, the "Reveal" control panel with 2-column type chips and accent-coloured sliders, the intro hero that blurs away.
- **Motion:** shader trail with persistence and eased close; intro fades up and blurs out on first move. Reduced motion swaps the live shader for the static crossfade.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |

| Page | `src/app/apps/fire-reveal/page.tsx` + `FireRevealClient.tsx` (client-only) |
| UI | `src/components/reveal/` (`FireRevealStudio.tsx`, `RevealPlane.tsx`) |

| Saved data | none — uploaded images stay in the browser tab (object URLs), settings reset on reload |

# Friends Night Out

`/apps/friends-night-out` · Apps · live · shows as: hub tile

> Find the night nobody posted about

An event finder built around the events nobody hears about. You set a point on the map and a radius, and it shows two things at once. One is what's happening (concerts, festivals, church gatherings, markets, block parties). The other is what you can go do any day (ice rinks, climbing walls, stables, kayak launches, drive-ins). Its "obscurity score" puts the single-source local find above the stadium tour everyone already posted about. It works with no API keys and saves on your device, synced to your account.

![Friends Night Out](../../public/look/friends-night-out.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Setup and header**

- **First-run setup** — "Use my location" (browser) or "type a town" (OpenStreetMap Nominatim, debounced to 1 request/s), radius 10/15/25/40/60/100 mi (default 25), or try a demo. `src/components/friends-night-out/Onboarding.tsx`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/geo.ts`, `src/app/api/fno/geocode/route.ts`
- **Demo mode** — invented listings with an amber "Demo data — these listings are invented. Set your real location" bar. `src/lib/friends-night-out/seed.ts`, `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`
- **Location + radius control in the header** — tap the place name to set it again; radius dropdown re-runs both searches. `RadiusControl` in `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`
- **Four tabs** — Upcoming, Always On, Date Night, Inbox. `TABS` in `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`
- **Instant board from cache, refreshed behind it** — last results show at once, then both searches re-run. `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`, `cacheEvents`/`cachePlaces` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts`

**Upcoming (dated events)**

- **Merged multi-source search** — Ticketmaster, community RSS / iCal / JSON-LD calendars, followed organizers, your watchlist and a verified AI web sweep run in parallel. One source failing never fails the search. `src/app/api/fno/search/route.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/ticketmaster.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/feeds.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/organizers.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/aiSweep.ts`
- **Obscurity score and confidence** — results from every source are merged, de-duplicated and scored. A recurring series discounts obscurity, and confidence is a gate, not a multiplier. `src/lib/friends-night-out/normalize.ts`
- **Sort "For you" (default) or "Hidden gems"** — For you filters on confidence first, then ranks by obscurity. `src/components/friends-night-out/UpcomingView.tsx`, `sortEvents` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/normalize.ts`
- **Filters** — price (Any / Free / Paid / Donation / Unlisted), room size (Under 100, 100–500, 500–2,000, 2,000+), kind of event, hidden gems only, and one venue. `src/components/friends-night-out/UpcomingView.tsx`, `VENUE_SIZE_LABELS` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/types.ts`
- **Grouped by time** — This weekend, Next 7 days, This month. Times are read in the viewer's time zone. `src/components/friends-night-out/UpcomingView.tsx`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/time.ts`
- **Event card** — "◈ Hidden gem" badge with its obscurity score, ★ watchlist match, series chip ("N dates found"), colour-coded price chip, link to the source, "See everything else at this venue", "I'm in" / "Going", and Save. `src/components/friends-night-out/EventCard.tsx`, `src/components/friends-night-out/chips.tsx`
- **Honest price colours** — Free (green), Paid (amber), Donation (violet), "Price not listed" (grey). An unknown price is never guessed. `TIER_STYLE` in `src/components/friends-night-out/chips.tsx`

**Always On (standing and seasonal places)**

- **Keyless places board** — OpenStreetMap places through Overpass (requests spread across mirrors, retried), plus a Wikipedia "hook line" per place. Works with no setup. `src/app/api/fno/places/route.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/overpass.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/wikipedia.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/categories.ts`
- **Sorted by obscurity, not distance** — distance is a filter here, not the sort order. `src/components/friends-night-out/AlwaysOnView.tsx`
- **"✦ Surprise me"** — hands you one place in a "Go here" panel. `src/components/friends-night-out/AlwaysOnView.tsx`
- **Filters** — category (Everything / …), vibe (Free & Weird, Big View, Only One Near You, Locally Owned, …), "Open this season", "No chains". `src/components/friends-night-out/AlwaysOnView.tsx`, `src/components/friends-night-out/chips.tsx`
- **Place card** — hook line, chain chip, "nearby" (other finds within a mile), dismiss ("Stop showing me this", remembered), Save, link out. `src/components/friends-night-out/PlaceCard.tsx`, `dismissPlace` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts`

**Date Night**

- **Whole evenings, composed** — each plan pairs an activity, an event and a food stop, with a cost range ("treat this as a floor" when a price isn't published; food estimated at $20–45 a head). If nothing clears the bar, it says so instead of padding the list. `src/components/friends-night-out/DateNightView.tsx`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/dateNight.ts`
- **"↻ Another three" / "start over" / "Save this evening"**. `src/components/friends-night-out/DateNightView.tsx`, `savePlan` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts`

**Inbox (things you found yourself)**

- **Paste a link → event** — Instagram, Facebook or any page is read into a form you check before adding. A date is required, and nothing is added automatically. `src/components/friends-night-out/InboxView.tsx`, `src/app/api/fno/extract/route.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/social.ts`
- **Photograph a flyer → event** — an image is read by a vision model into the same form. `src/components/friends-night-out/InboxView.tsx`, `extractFromImage` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/social.ts`
- **Follow the organizer behind a link** — "That link belongs to X. Follow them" prompt, plus a "Following" list with unfollow. `src/components/friends-night-out/InboxView.tsx`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/organizers.ts`
- **Inbox events show in Upcoming straight away**. `allEvents` in `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`

**Sources panel**

- **Source status** — a "Sources n/m" button opens a side panel with each source's ok/error state and reason. `src/components/friends-night-out/SourcesPanel.tsx`
- **Community calendars** — "Find calendars near me" (discovery, accept each one), "Or paste an RSS / iCal URL", plus turn on/off and remove. `src/components/friends-night-out/SourcesPanel.tsx`, `src/app/api/fno/discover/route.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/sources/discover.ts`
- **Watchlist** — artists, venues and promoters you follow get flagged on matching events. `src/components/friends-night-out/SourcesPanel.tsx`, `addWatch` in `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts`
- **AI sweep on/off**. `src/components/friends-night-out/SourcesPanel.tsx`

**Accounts and AI spend**

- **AI only for signed-in visitors** — the AI sweep, the link/flyer reader and place rating need a hub sign-in when Supabase is configured. Local mode keeps AI. `src/lib/friends-night-out/aiAccess.ts`
- **Follows you across devices** — saved events, places, plans, feeds and preferences sync to your account. The cached results are left out of the sync. `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts` (`KEY = "friends-night-out:v1"`, `pushRemote`), `useRemotePull` in `src/components/friends-night-out/FriendsNightOut.tsx`

**Server-only: any-city places catalog (no screen uses it yet)**

- **Any-city builder** — streams progress, reuses a city area that already covers the point, uses perplexity/sonar web discovery (`FNO_DISCOVERY_MODEL`) for food, gems, parks, kids and fun, and checks every find against a named OSM element in the radius. `src/app/api/fno/areas/build/route.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/catalog/build.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/catalog/verify.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/areas.ts`
- **Sections + blended AI/community stars** — sections Parks and outside / Fun / Unique gems / Kids / Food. AI stars are rated in rounds, and out-of-credit (402) is detected. `src/lib/friends-night-out/sections.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/stars.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/catalog/rubric.ts`, `src/lib/friends-night-out/catalog/ai.ts`, `src/app/api/fno/areas/[id]/rate/route.ts`, `src/app/api/fno/areas/[id]/places/route.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** dark DESIGN.md canvas, but written as hard-coded hex values in inline styles and Tailwind arbitrary classes rather than tokens. No design skill is recorded for it.
- **Colours / type:** background `#0a0b0f`, text `#e9ecf3`, muted `#6b7385` / `#7c839a` / `#5b6478`, panels `#101219` with borders `#20242f` / `#1a1e26`, active tab `#1a1e28`. Its own accent is a pink→sky gradient (`rgba(236,72,153)` → `rgba(56,189,248)`, text `#f0abfc` / `#f9a8d4`) for Hidden gem, Surprise me and Another three. Price chips: free `#6ee7b7`, paid `#fcd34d`, donation `#c4b5fd`, unknown `#94a3b8`. The demo bar is amber `#d4a15e` on `#161208`. It uses the system sans font (no mono or serif).
- **Layout:** sticky blurred header (← OS · title · location|radius · Sources n/m) with a scrolling tab row. Main area is max-w-6xl. On a laptop: content plus a 320px Sources panel when it is open (`lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]`). On a phone: one column, with the tabs scrolling sideways.
- **Signature pieces:** the glowing "◈ Hidden gem" badge (`GemBadge` in `chips.tsx`), colour-edged price chips, the Surprise-me "Go here" panel, Date Night evening cards.
- **Motion:** minimal. Colour transitions and `animate-pulse` loading skeletons. There is no custom reduced-motion handling (nothing large moves).

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/friends-night-out/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/friends-night-out/` |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/friends-night-out/` (`sources/`, `catalog/`) |
| API | `src/app/api/fno/` (`search`, `places`, `discover`, `extract`, `geocode`, `areas/build`, `areas/[id]/places`, `areas/[id]/rate`) |
| Saved data | synced key `friends-night-out:v1` (localStorage + app_state, via `src/lib/friends-night-out/store.ts`); Supabase tables `fno_areas`, `fno_places` for the any-city catalog (`supabase/migrations/20260919000000_fno_social.sql`). Optional env: `TICKETMASTER_API_KEY`, `EVENTBRITE_TOKEN`, `AI_MODEL`, `FNO_DISCOVERY_MODEL` |

## Owner's rules for this app

- Hidden gems come first. Obscurity outranks popularity, but "For you" first filters on confidence so the top of the list is both obscure and believable.
- An unknown price stays an honest grey "Price not listed". Never guess it.
- It must be usable with **no API keys at all**: location, places and the demo are all keyless.
- Never scrape Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. The app accepts what the user pastes or photographs instead.
- Nothing from a link or flyer is added without the user confirming the form.

# Game Creator

`/apps/game-creator` · Apps · live · shows as: section of Game Studio (Create) — `/apps/game-creator` redirects to `/apps/game-studio?section=create`; game pages stay at `/apps/game-creator/<id>`

> Describe a game → Unreal Engine builds it

Type an idea for a video game and Unreal Engine 5.8 on the owner's own PC builds it. A builder
program on the PC picks up each prompt and runs Claude Code with the `unreal-game-builder` skill:
it writes a one-page design, creates a Blueprint project from the right engine template, builds the
gameplay through Epic's in-editor MCP tools, playtests it, takes screenshots from the player's eye
and packages a Windows game. Every game lands in a gallery that updates live while it is built;
a finished game opens in Unreal or launches to play on the PC that built it.

![Game Creator](../../public/look/game-creator.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Make a game** (`src/components/game-creator/GameCreator.tsx`)

- **Prompt box** — "Describe a game. Your PC builds it."; Ctrl/⌘+Enter submits; 8–4,000 characters. `GameCreator.tsx`, `src/app/api/game-creator/games/route.ts`

OpenRouter ones are disabled until the PC reports a key; the server also refuses them. Choice remembered in localStorage `gc-model`. `types.ts` (`BUILD_MODELS`), `GameCreator.tsx`, `games/route.ts`
- **Queue line** — "Your PC is ready to build" / "N in the queue — your PC builds one at a time" / "It will start as soon as your PC's builder is running". `GameCreator.tsx`
- **AI problem strip** — shows the hub AI switchboard's errors that concern the game builder. `src/components/hub/AiPanel.tsx` (`AiProblemStrip only="builder"`)

**Connect your PC** (`src/components/game-creator/BuilderSetup.tsx`)

- **Builder status** — green dot "Your PC is connected" + last check-in, amber "builder is offline", grey "Connect your PC". `BuilderSetup.tsx`

**Gallery**

- **Live gallery, newest first** — polls every 5 s while anything builds, every 20 s otherwise. `GameCreator.tsx`

**One game's page** (`/apps/game-creator/<id>`, `src/components/game-creator/GamePage.tsx`)

- **Screenshots** — big hero shot, thumbnail strip, full-screen viewer with captions, n/N, ←/→ and Esc. `GamePage.tsx`
- **Tabs** — Chat with the agent (default) · About · Design · Build log (N). `GamePage.tsx`
- **Chat with the build agent** — your messages interleaved with the agent's narration; each shows "the agent has it" / "waiting for your PC". During a build they join the running Claude session; on a finished game "Send and rebuild" starts a follow-up that resumes the same session on the same project. Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line, 2,000 chars max. `GamePage.tsx`, `src/app/api/game-creator/games/[id]/route.ts`, `tools/unreal-builder/builder.mjs`
- **About** — the prompt, summary, "Built" list, "Left out" list with reasons, and "Why the build stopped" for failures. `GamePage.tsx`
- **Design** — the skill's Design.md rendered as markdown. `GamePage.tsx`

- **Side card** — title, genre · template, queued time, Model, Skill with "loaded" (green) / "not confirmed" (amber). `GamePage.tsx`

ArenaShooter and SurvivalHorror variants, shooter AI left out so packaging works), launches the editor with Epic's MCP server and proxies its tools, real in-game screenshots, Poly Haven model/surface import, content-only Windows packaging, watchdog for the engine's hanging SDK check. `tools/unreal-bridge/server.mjs`, `lib/templates.mjs`, `lib/assets.mjs`, `lib/gameshot.mjs`, `lib/sdkcheck.mjs`
- **The skill** — design → project → Blueprint build → playtest → package → report, with a realism guide for gritty/AAA games. Backup copy in `skills/unreal-game-builder/` (`SKILL.md`, `references/realism.md`)

- **Look:** DESIGN.md "instrument panel" unchanged, plus a glowing hero card; no design-skill record found.

# Game Studio

> Make a game, finish the ones in progress

Every game in one place, behind one front door. **Create** is Game Creator: describe a game and
Unreal Engine on the owner's PC designs, builds, playtests, screenshots and packages it. **Unfinished
games** is a shelf of games that already play but are not done (Slippery Escape and Item Storm
Arena today) — each playable right in the list, with a **Finish it** button that hands the rest of
the work to Claude Code through the owner's In Queue.

![Game Studio](../../public/look/game-studio.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The shell**

- **Two sections: Create · Unfinished games** — a switcher bar with the brand "Game *Studio*", tagline and a Flag icon; Create hint "describe it, your PC builds it", Unfinished hint "play them, finish them". `src/components/game-studio/GameStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/studio-home/games.ts` (`GAME_SECTIONS`)
