# God's Eye View

`/apps/gods-eye-view` · Apps · live · shows as: App plugins card (Jarvis › App plugins; it is in `PLUGIN_SLUGS` in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`, so it is **not** a hub tile)

> A spy-satellite view of the real, live planet

A 3D globe in the browser dressed up as a spy-satellite console, showing real live data: planes, military
flights, satellites, earthquakes, ships, fires and about 24,000 public traffic cameras. The owner uses it
to look at anywhere on Earth and to grab a real location shot (a camera feed or a satellite view) for
video work. It is a port of the open-source project bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view (MIT licence).

![God's Eye View](../../public/look/gods-eye-view.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The globe and the console**

- **Boot screen** — "ESTABLISHING UPLINK" while the globe loads; "UPLINK FAILED" with a Back to hub button if it can't. `src/app/apps/gods-eye-view/GodsEyeClient.tsx`, `src/components/gods-eye/GodsEyeView.tsx`
- **3D globe (CesiumJS)** — Cesium is loaded from the jsDelivr CDN, never bundled. `src/lib/gods-eye/cesium.ts`, `src/lib/gods-eye/globe.ts`
- **Three map sources** — ESRI SATELLITE (works with no key), OSM, and GOOGLE 3D photorealistic cities. `src/components/gods-eye/GodsEyeView.tsx` (`MAP_SOURCES`), `src/lib/gods-eye/globe.ts`
- **POWER UP key box** — paste a Cesium ion token or Google Maps key (saved in this browser) to unlock 3D cities; shows "CONFIGURED EXTERNALLY" when the env var is set. `src/components/gods-eye/GodsEyeView.tsx`
- **Keyhole scope** — round scope mask with tick ring; switch KEYHOLE / FULL FRAME, sliders for FEATHER and OUTSIDE darkness. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `gods-eye.module.css` (`.scope`, `.scopeRing`)
- **Tactical HUD** — classification banner, LAT / LON / ALT, estimated GSD and NIIRS, heading and pitch, sun elevation, ORB/PASS stamp and a red REC UTC clock. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `src/lib/gods-eye/geo.ts`
- **HUD modes** — tactical → minimal → clean (hidden, for clean recordings), cycled with the HUD button or the H key. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `src/lib/gods-eye/commands.ts` (`HudMode`)
- **Detection boxes** — box labels drawn on contacts, off / sparse / dense, with a DENSITY slider, ELASTIC vs WEIGHTED label sharing, and a FADE slider. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `src/lib/gods-eye/globe.ts` (`setDetection`)
- **Seven sensor looks** — NORMAL, CRT, NVG (night vision), FLIR thermal (IRONBOW or WHITE-HOT), ANIME, NOIR, SNOW, on keys 1–7; GLSL shaders from the original. `src/lib/gods-eye/shaders.ts` (`STYLES`)
- **Display switches** — DAY / NIGHT lighting, ORBIT DRIFT (auto-rotate), CELESTIAL (real sun, moon, stars). `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `globe.ts` (`setCelestial`)
- **3D aircraft models** — swap aircraft icons for a 3D plane model: off / proximity / all (capped). `globe.ts` (`setModelMode`, `AIRCRAFT_MODEL_URL`)
- **Location presets + place search** — LOCATION tray with Austin, San Francisco, New York, London, Tokyo, Dubai, Paris, Sydney… plus a search box (Photon / OpenStreetMap). `src/lib/gods-eye/commands.ts` (`LOCATIONS`), `src/lib/gods-eye/feeds.ts` (`search`)
- **First-view picker** — on first visit choose LIVE CONTACTS, SPACE MISSIONS, ENVIRONMENTAL or EXPLORE MANUALLY, with "don't show again". `GodsEyeView.tsx` (`chooseFirstView`)
- **Share a view as a link** — ⧉ LINK copies a URL whose hash holds the camera, sensor look, layers and map source; opening it restores the view. `GodsEyeView.tsx` (`readHash`)
- **RESET and ⟵ HUB buttons** — reset flies back to the whole Earth (also the R key). `GodsEyeView.tsx`
- **Collapsible side panels** — LAYERS panel on the left, DISPLAY panel on the right. `GodsEyeView.tsx`

**Live data layers** (left panel, each with its source, colour dot and live / stale / error status)

- **Live Flights** — OpenSky, with adsb.lol near you when OpenSky is throttled; planes glide between updates by dead reckoning. `src/lib/gods-eye/feeds.ts`, `globe.ts`
- **Military Flights** — from adsb.lol. `feeds.ts`
- **Satellites** — thousands of CelesTrak orbits, moved in the browser with SGP4 (satellite.js pinned to v6). `feeds.ts`, `globe.ts`
- **Earthquakes (24 h)** — USGS. `feeds.ts`
- **CCTV · Traffic Cams** — ~24,000 official keyless cameras from 23 open-data networks (TfL, fifteen 511 DOT sites, NYC DOT, Caltrans, DriveBC, Digitraffic, NZTA, Hong Kong, Singapore), loaded one network per request to fit Vercel's size limit; plus up to 200 Windy webcams when `WINDY_WEBCAMS_API_KEY` is set. Streaming cameras are drawn cyan, stills green. `src/lib/gods-eye/cameras.ts`
- **Submarine Cables** — TeleGeography map. `feeds.ts`
- **Space Missions (±30 days)** — Launch Library. `src/lib/gods-eye/extra-feeds.ts`
- **Vessels (AIS)** — needs `AISSTREAM_API_KEY`. `extra-feeds.ts`
- **Street Traffic** — TomTom flow tiles, needs `TOMTOM_API_KEY` (kept server-side by a tile proxy). `src/app/api/gods-eye/traffic/[z]/[x]/[y]/route.ts`
- **FIRMS Active Fires** — NASA, needs `NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY`. `extra-feeds.ts`
- **Datacenters and Dams** — static snapshots in `public/gods-eye/datacenters.json` and `dams.json`, rebuilt by `scripts/gods-eye-snapshot.mjs`. `globe.ts`
- **Caching feed proxy** — every feed goes through one server route with its own TTL and serves its last good copy when the source fails. `src/app/api/gods-eye/[feed]/route.ts`, `src/lib/gods-eye/cache.ts`

**Lock on, track and fly**

- **Click anything to lock on** — selection card with telemetry fields, a fading trail for moving targets, and orbit lines for satellites; TRACK / RELEASE / FOCUS. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `globe.ts`
- **Hover preview** — hovering a contact shows a small card (with a camera's picture). `GodsEyeView.tsx` (`hoverCard`)
- **Cockpit (first person)** — ride any live aircraft: compass tape, horizon, ground speed, heading, altitude, vertical speed, nearby traffic, PREV / NEXT / EXIT COCKPIT. `GodsEyeView.tsx` (cockpit block), `globe.ts` (`CockpitInfo`)
- **CONTEXT card** — CONTACTS tab (aircraft and ships within 250 km, previous / focus / next / cockpit) and SPACE MISSIONS tab (upcoming soonest first). `GodsEyeView.tsx`
- **SCENES** — capture shots (view + look + layers), load, delete, START plays them in order, EXPORT / IMPORT as a file. `GodsEyeView.tsx` (`readShots`, `exportShots`, `importShots`)

**Traffic cameras**

- **Live camera card** — tag reads LIVE VIDEO, LIVE CLIP or STILL (amber dot); HLS streams play with hls.js; stills poll every second and only swap when a genuinely new frame arrives, reporting the agency's real publish gap. `src/components/gods-eye/LiveCam.tsx`
- **Enlarge** — click a still to open a big centred viewer with a red close X (Esc closes); the small card pauses so a camera streams once. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `LiveCam.tsx`
- **PREV / NEXT / AUTO HOP** — move between nearby cameras, or hop automatically. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `globe.ts` (`cycleCamera`)
- **VIDEO ONLY + NEAREST LIVE VIDEO** — only visit streaming cameras (search out to 400 km); the button probes the closest streams and flies to the first that answers. `GodsEyeView.tsx`, `globe.ts` (`cycleCamera`, nearest-stream probe)

**Talk to it**

- **Typed commands** — "fly to Tokyo", "thermal", "turn on satellites", "track the ISS", "reset globe" work offline through a local parser. `src/lib/gods-eye/commands.ts` (`parseCommand`, tested in `commands.test.ts`)
- **Voice agent (hold Space)** — browser speech-to-text, then a tool-calling Claude turn on the server (STD = Claude Sonnet 5, MINI = Claude Haiku 4.5) that can fly, switch layers / looks / HUD / detection, track, cockpit, mark a place, orbit, draw a real road / foot / bike route and fly it, and drive the radio; replies are spoken aloud (toggle) and shown in a transcript with NEW. Falls back to local commands when there is no AI key. `src/lib/gods-eye/agent.ts`, `src/app/api/gods-eye/agent/route.ts`, `GodsEyeView.tsx` (`askAgent`, `speak`)
- **Radio scanner** — NOAA Weather Radio, police / fire / EMS / ATC scanner feeds and local stations near the view, with volume, prev / pause / next / stop and a live level meter. `src/components/gods-eye/RadioDeck.tsx`, `src/lib/gods-eye/radio.ts`
- **Keyboard** — 1–7 sensor looks, H HUD, R reset, hold Space to talk, Esc closes the enlarged camera. `GodsEyeView.tsx`

## How it looks

- **Look:** "spy-satellite console" — a full-screen globe behind a keyhole scope with a tactical HUD, taken from the original project's design. No hub design skill is recorded for it; there is no `.impeccable/surfaces` file for it.
- **Colours / type:** own palette on `.root` in `src/components/gods-eye/gods-eye.module.css`, ignoring DESIGN.md's tokens: background `#050811`, ink `#d8f6ff`, dim `#7aa3b3`, cyan `#00f0ff` (lines and accents), amber `#ffb020`, red `#ff3b3b`, green `#39ff88`, glass panels `rgba(4,12,22,0.72)`, cyan hairlines `rgba(0,240,255,0.28)`. Each data layer has its own colour (`LAYERS` in `globe.ts`). Fonts: **Chakra Petch** (titles) and **JetBrains Mono** (everything else) via `next/font`, 11px uppercase text with wide letter-spacing.
- **Layout:** laptop — globe fills the screen; brand + HUD readout top-left, controls top-centre, LAYERS panel left, DISPLAY / CONTEXT panel right, a dock along the bottom with location presets, the command / voice bar, sensor looks and map sources. Phone (≤860px) — top-right block hidden, side panels narrower and pushed down, dock stacks to one column, voice label hidden, street-traffic readout hidden, scope slightly smaller.
- **Signature pieces:** the keyhole scope ring, scan-line overlay, "TOP SECRET // SI-TK // NOFORN" banner, blinking red REC dot, detection boxes on a canvas over the globe, the cockpit instrument row, the enlarged camera viewer with a red X.
- **Motion:** boot bar sweep, REC blink, pulse and toast-in animations, camera viewer pop-in, ORBIT DRIFT auto-rotation, aircraft dead-reckoning glide. There is **no reduced-motion fallback** in this app's CSS or code.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/gods-eye-view/page.tsx` + `GodsEyeClient.tsx` (client-only dynamic import, no SSR) |
| UI | `src/components/gods-eye/` (`GodsEyeView.tsx`, `LiveCam.tsx`, `RadioDeck.tsx`, `gods-eye.module.css`) |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/gods-eye/` (`globe.ts` engine, `shaders.ts`, `feeds.ts`, `extra-feeds.ts`, `cameras.ts`, `radio.ts`, `agent.ts`, `commands.ts` + test, `geo.ts` + test, `cache.ts`, `cesium.ts`, `types.ts`) |
| API | `src/app/api/gods-eye/[feed]/route.ts` (flights, military, satellites, quakes, cameras, webcams, launches, fires, vessels, radio, cables, search), `agent/route.ts`, `traffic/[z]/[x]/[y]/route.ts` |
| Saved data | This browser only (localStorage): `gods-eye-view.keys`, `gods-eye-view.scenes`, `gods-eye-view.first-view-dismissed`, `gods-eye-view.agent`. Views live in the URL hash. Server keeps feed caches in memory and camera lists in `tmpdir/gods-eye-view/cameras-v3`. No Supabase. |

## Owner's rules for this app

- Must work with no keys: Esri imagery and the keyless layers are the default; key-gated layers say which env var they need (`NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY`, `AISSTREAM_API_KEY`, `TOMTOM_API_KEY`, `WINDY_WEBCAMS_API_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CESIUM_ION_TOKEN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY`).
- Cameras: never label a still as LIVE — say LIVE VIDEO, LIVE CLIP or STILL. Stream URLs are limited to hosts verified to serve a public, CORS-enabled playlist.
- Load camera networks one per request — one combined response broke Vercel's 4.5 MB limit and left the layer empty in production.
- Keep satellite.js pinned to v6 (v7's WASM will not bundle) and keep Cesium and hls.js on the CDN.
- Only https radio streams (browsers block http audio on the https hub).
- Datacenters and dams are snapshots; regenerate with `node scripts/gods-eye-snapshot.mjs`, never query them live.
- AI calls go through the hub provider (`src/lib/ai/provider.ts`), never a hard-coded gateway.

## Described but not found in code

- None found. (The catalog says "~25,000" cameras; the code and change log say about 24,000 from 23 networks plus optional Windy webcams.)

# H3 Experiments

`/apps/h3-experiments` · Video · live · shows as: hub tile (it is in none of `PLUGIN_SLUGS`, `TOOLBOX_SLUGS`, `WIDGET_SLUGS` or `MERGED_INTO` in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`; not in `UNPREVIEWABLE`, so the hub carousel runs it live on its panel)

> Which skill actually makes a good film

A lab notebook for AI video. Every way the owner has of making or fixing a film (a prompting skill, a
model, a post-process tool, an outside workflow) is a folder; the same short story ("brief") is given
to each, and every film that comes back is filed, watched, rated and tagged with what went wrong. It
exists because films were being made with different methods and nobody recorded which method made
which, so the same lessons kept being re-learned.

![H3 Experiments](../../public/look/h3-experiments.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

- **A folder per method, grouped by kind** — left list grouped Skills · Tools · Models · Workflows with a count per group; 18 seeded methods (the five h3-* prompting skills, viggle-motion-swap, film-plan, shot-plan-storyboard, H3 Face Refiner, Phantom 14B, StandIn, Lynx, VACE 14B, K5 Lite, LTX-2, Hunyuan 1.5, OpenVideo, minimax_h3_workflow). `src/lib/h3-lab/methods.ts` (`SEED_METHODS`, `KIND_ORDER`), `src/components/h3-lab/H3Lab.tsx`
- **"Untried" mark** — an amber dot on any method that has never produced footage, so unused tools stand out. `src/lib/h3-lab/methods.ts` (`status`), `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Score per method** — each row shows good count (green), bad count (red) and total runs. `src/lib/h3-lab/types.ts` (`skillScore`), `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Live skill descriptions** — for the skill-type methods, the description is read from that skill's `SKILL.md` on disk (`~/.claude/skills` or repo `skills/`), so editing a skill updates it here. `src/app/api/h3-lab/skills/route.ts`
- **Method dossier** — right pane shows the method's name, kind, used / untried status, description, the owner's note, its source link (repo URL or WanGP model id) and the current brief's story. `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Briefs (the controlled variable)** — "+ brief" asks for a title and the story in plain words; a dropdown in the header switches the current brief. `H3Lab.tsx` (`addBrief`), `src/lib/h3-lab/types.ts` (`Brief`)
- **Runs list, one dense row per film** — skill, length, shot count, settings and a verdict dot; newest first. `src/components/h3-lab/ScrubRow.tsx`, `types.ts` (`runsForSkill`)
- **Hover plays, drag scrubs** — hovering a row plays the film faintly behind the text; the row's width is the timeline, so moving or dragging across it scrubs; a white scrub line follows the pointer. The video only loads on first hover. `ScrubRow.tsx`
- **File a film from disk** — "on disk, unfiled" lists finished renders no run has claimed yet; one click files it under the selected method and brief. `H3Lab.tsx` (`claim`), `src/app/api/h3-lab/films/route.ts`
- **Run record** — full video player with controls, editable length and shots, "settings that actually applied", notes ("what was actually wrong or right"), and "remove this record". `H3Lab.tsx` (dossier, `patch`)
- **Verdict** — good / mixed / bad (green / amber / red), tap again to clear. `H3Lab.tsx` (`VERDICTS`)
- **Defect tags from a fixed list** — identity drift, style break, dead shot, locked landing, wrong direction, prop never acted, creature off-model, no threat, bad join, flat pacing. `H3Lab.tsx` (`DEFECTS`)
- **Defects counted per method** — "its defects, counted" tally in the dossier, so one bad film becomes a pattern. `types.ts` (`defectTally`), `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Queue view** — lists every method × brief pair that has never been rendered, with a count badge on the tab; "skip" waves one off; clicking a method jumps to its runs. `types.ts` (`openGaps`, `gapId`), `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Works on the deployed site as a ledger** — when the render folder isn't there (Vercel), it says "No local renders visible — this is the deployed hub" and records still sync. `films/route.ts`, `H3Lab.tsx`
- **Streams films with seeking** — the films route serves byte ranges (206) so scrubbing works, and only reads `.mp4/.webm/.mov` files inside the render folder (blocks `..` paths). `src/app/api/h3-lab/films/route.ts` (`resolveInside`)
- **Syncs between devices** — briefs, runs and skipped gaps save under one synced key. `H3Lab.tsx` (`saveSynced`, `useRemotePull`), `src/lib/sync/appState.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** dense "lab ledger" — three panes of monospace rows, no cards. No design skill or `.impeccable/surfaces` record is stored for it; it does not use the DESIGN.md tokens.
- **Colours / type:** plain Tailwind classes in `H3Lab.tsx` / `ScrubRow.tsx`: page `#0a0a0b`, text `neutral-300` (headings `neutral-100`, labels `neutral-600`), hairlines `white/10` and `white/5`, selected row `white/[0.07]`. Status colours: emerald-400 good, amber-400 mixed / untried / queue badge, rose-500 bad and defect tags. Type is the system monospace (`font-mono`) at 10–13px; small uppercase wide-tracked section labels.
- **Layout:** laptop — header (title, runs / queue tabs, brief picker, + brief), then skills list on the left (w-48 → w-64 on wide screens), runs or queue in the middle, dossier on the right (20rem → 26rem). Phone — the dossier pane is hidden below the `md` breakpoint (`hidden md:block`), so only the skills list and runs show; there is no phone-specific layout.
- **Signature pieces:** `ScrubRow` — the row that is also the film, with the faded video behind the text and the scrub line; the amber "untried" dots; the queue count badge.
- **Motion:** only colour / opacity transitions and the hover video. Reduced motion: rows never autoplay — you get a still frame you can still scrub (`ScrubRow.tsx`).

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/h3-experiments/page.tsx` (renders `H3Lab`) |
| UI | `src/components/h3-lab/` (`H3Lab.tsx`, `ScrubRow.tsx`) — the folder is named `h3-lab`, not the slug |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/h3-lab/` (`methods.ts` seed registry, `types.ts` state + pure helpers). No tests. |
| API | `src/app/api/h3-lab/skills/route.ts` (methods + live descriptions), `src/app/api/h3-lab/films/route.ts` (list renders / stream one) |
| Saved data | Synced key `h3lab:v1` (Supabase `app_state` via `src/lib/sync/appState.ts`). Footage is NOT saved — it is read from `tools/studio-bridge/out/films` on the PC. |

## Owner's rules for this app

- A method is something that can actually make or repair footage. Do **not** list every skill whose text mentions "video" — an earlier version did and swept in website builders and design skills, which made the list useless. Add a method by adding it to `SEED_METHODS` in `src/lib/h3-lab/methods.ts`.
- "untried" is the honest flag: it means installed or available but never run. Those rows are meant to bother the owner — don't hide them.
- Every method must render the same brief for the comparison to mean anything; runs are always filed under a brief.
- The Queue exists because undone work should be visible rather than remembered — keep it.
- Defects come from the fixed list so they tally; don't make them free text.

## Described but not found in code

- "Skills are read off disk, so adding one to the library adds it here" (catalog overview, `src/lib/catalog.ts`) — not true in code: the list is the hard-coded `SEED_METHODS` in `src/lib/h3-lab/methods.ts`; disk is only read to refresh the description of skills already in that list (`src/app/api/h3-lab/skills/route.ts`).
- "The tags are counted per skill" (catalog overview) — works for skills, but the dossier calls `defectTally(state, activeSkill.name)` while runs store the method **id**, so for tools / models / workflows whose name differs from their id (e.g. "H3 Face Refiner" vs `h3_face_refiner`) the tally never shows (`src/components/h3-lab/H3Lab.tsx`).

# Hub

`/` · the site shell (not a catalog entry) · live · shows as: the website itself — the front page, app detail pages, login, legal pages, gates and crash screens around every app

> Your apps, in one place

The hub is the whole Next.js site that holds every app the owner builds: the front page that lists
what has not moved into Jarvis yet, a detail page for every app in the catalog, Google sign-in, the
owner-only gate, the password gates, the public legal pages, and the crash screens. Only the owner
gets past `/` when accounts are switched on; everyone else is sent to Friends Night Out. Every other
doc in `docs/apps/` describes one app *inside* this shell.

![Hub](../../public/look/hub.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Which apps the hub shows**
- **One catalog, one source of truth** — every app is one object in `PROJECTS`; adding an app = adding one object. `src/lib/catalog.ts`
- **The hub shows only what has not moved** — `hubProjects()` = catalog minus App plugins (`PLUGIN_SLUGS`), Toolbox tabs (`TOOLBOX_SLUGS`), Dashboard widgets (`WIDGET_SLUGS`) and apps merged into a studio home (`MERGED_INTO`), so no app has two front doors. Today that leaves 8 tiles: Jarvis, Tap Safe (`std-safe`), Friends Night Out, H3 Experiments, Smart Shot Videos, Video Studio Arena, 3D Studio, Realtime Lucy. `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`
- **Live previews picked automatically** — `previewFor()` gives every live app with a route a running preview of itself; `noPreview` (Realtime Lucy, Baby No Scroll, Dump Finder) and the private `UNPREVIEWABLE` list (Dashboard, Jarvis, Projects Timeline, Trading Studio, Personas Studio, Client Review, App Builder, etc.) keep the animated icon instead. A project may also set `preview: {kind:"video"|"site"}`. `src/lib/catalog.ts` (`previewFor`, `previewUrl`, `UNPREVIEWABLE`)

**Front page `/` — layout switch**

**Front page — V1 gallery (the default)**

- **Search box** — filters by title, tag line or category as you type. `src/components/hub/HubHome.tsx`

- **"AI · <provider>" status pill** — coloured dot (green / amber / red) and a count of problems, polled every 60 s from `/api/ai/status`. `src/components/hub/AiPanel.tsx`
- **Red problem strip** — anything actually broken shows across the top in plain words; dismissible for the tab session. `src/components/hub/AiPanel.tsx` (`AiProblemStrip`)

**Bottom navigation (front page, detail pages, Favorites, Settings)**

**App detail page `/p/<slug>`**
- **A page for every catalog app** — including ones that have moved into Jarvis (pre-rendered for all of `PROJECTS`); unknown slug → 404. `src/app/p/[slug]/page.tsx`
- **Hero** — big animated icon, category · tag line, title, full overview, "Back to hub". `src/app/p/[slug]/page.tsx`

**Other hub pages**
- **Favorites `/favorites`** — "No favorites yet" screen with a Browse projects button (placeholder: nothing can be starred yet). `src/app/favorites/page.tsx`
- **Settings `/settings`** — three fixed rows (Storage, AI engine, Modules); the values are hard-coded text, not live state. `src/app/settings/page.tsx`
- **Old review links** — `/review` → `/apps/client-review`; `/review/<code>` → `/apps/client-review?site=<code>`. `src/app/review/page.tsx`, `src/app/review/[token]/page.tsx`

**Sign-in and who can see what**
- **Login `/login` — one "Continue with Google" button** — the same button creates an account; Google One Tap also offers itself automatically when `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is set. `src/app/login/page.tsx`, `src/lib/auth/google.ts`

- **No accounts mode** — without Supabase keys the login page says so and offers "Continue to app" (local demo mode). `src/app/login/page.tsx`
- **OAuth callback** — `/auth/callback` swaps the code for a session and returns to `next` (or `/login` on failure). `src/app/auth/callback/route.ts`
- **Owner-only hub** — every page and API is owner-only unless listed otherwise; owners are the emails in `HUB_OWNER_EMAILS` (unset = nobody, fail-closed). Signed-out → `/login` (APIs get a 401 JSON); signed-in non-owner → `/apps/friends-night-out` (APIs get 403). A signed-in visitor on `/login` is sent home. `src/middleware.ts`, `src/lib/hubAccess.ts` (+ `hubAccess.test.ts`)
- **Public paths** — Friends Night Out and `/api/fno`, Client Review (`/apps/client-review`, `/review`, `/api/client-review/portal`, `/client-review-sw.js`), `/legal/*`, and the exact file `/jarvis-errors.js`. `src/lib/hubAccess.ts`

**Legal pages (public — TikTok and Meta require them)**
- **Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Delete your data** — plain-language pages about Personas Studio, linked to each other, with a contact line from `LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL`. `src/app/legal/LegalPage.tsx`, `src/app/legal/privacy/page.tsx`, `src/app/legal/terms/page.tsx`, `src/app/legal/data-deletion/page.tsx`

**Site-wide plumbing**
- **Root layout** — dark theme colour `#0a0b0f`, phone viewport with zoom locked (`maximumScale: 1`), mounts `IdentityBoundary` and `ErrorReporter` on every page. `src/app/layout.tsx`
- **Redirects / rewrites** — `/apps/ea-world` and `/apps/ea-lab` → Trading Studio sections; `/pod-play-connect/*` serves its prebuilt bundle. `next.config.mjs`

## How it looks

- **Look:** "The Night Console" (`DESIGN.md`): a near-black instrument panel where colour only reports state, monospace is reserved for machine facts, surfaces are separated by tone and 1px hairlines rather than shadows, and dense tables beat card grids. The V2 stand is modelled on a desk rotary reference stand (black hinged holders on a hub and weighted base). No design-skill record for the hub page itself was found in `.impeccable/`.
- **Colours / type:** tokens in `src/app/globals.css` `@theme` — canvas `#0a0b0f`, panel `#12141c`, panel-2 `#181b25`, elevated `#1d212d`, line `#262a38`, ink `#e9ecf3` / muted `#9aa3b5` / faint `#6b7385`, brand indigo `#6366f1` / `#4f46e5`, core green `#22c55e`, support blue `#3b82f6`, cyan accent `#00cae0`. Fonts: system sans (`--font-sans`) and JetBrains Mono (`--font-mono`). Each app tile's colours come from its own two catalog `hue` values. **What the hub does differently from DESIGN.md:** the front page breaks the 14px ceiling on purpose (24–30px hero, 36px detail title), uses a card-style icon grid with soft coloured icon shadows and a shadowed popover, and `hub-v2.css` adds its own hard-coded darks (`#14161e`→`#0e1016` holder gradient, `#2a2f3d` border, `#0b0d13` page art, silver tab `#e8ecf5`→`#aeb6c8`), an indigo floor glow `hsl(243 70% 60%)` and an indigo glow on the focused panel. The crash screen uses inline colours (`#0a0b0f` background, `#3b82f6` button) so it works even when the stylesheet failed. Login's Google button is white with Google's four-colour mark (their brand rule).
- **Layout:** V1 laptop — one centred column (`max-w-5xl`), header, hero, full-width search, chip row, 5–6-column icon grid, bottom nav. V1 phone — same column, 3-column grid, chips scroll sideways, no popovers. V2 — full-height stage (`100dvh`, no page scroll), ring centred at 46% height, read-out and arrows under it, bottom nav on top; panel size scales with the window (170–250px wide). The V1/V2 pill sits fixed top-right with the AI pill to its left; the AI panel opens as a 400px dropdown on a laptop and a near-full-width sheet on a phone. Detail page: one column `max-w-3xl`, hero stacks centred on a phone and sits icon-left on a laptop.
- **Signature pieces:** the animated catalog icons, the V1/V2 pill, the rotating stand with its spine tab on each panel and the one live iframe on the front panel, the AI status pill, the floating bottom nav.
- **Motion:** icons animate continuously in CSS (aurora drift, orbit spin, ring pulse, mesh, wave) and lift on hover; panels fade in with `animate-fade-in` (180 ms). The carousel is physics, not CSS transitions — velocity, friction, snap spring, squeeze while spinning — written to the DOM every frame. Reduced motion: icon animations stop (`.hub-icon * { animation: none }`), the carousel drops its blur and hides preview video (`.hubv2-media`), but the ring still turns when you drive it.

## Where the code is

|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/page.tsx` (front page), `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/p/[slug]/page.tsx`, `src/app/login/page.tsx`, `src/app/auth/callback/route.ts`, `src/app/favorites/page.tsx`, `src/app/settings/page.tsx`, `src/app/legal/`, `src/app/timeline-unlock/`, `src/app/recall-unlock/`, `src/app/recall-join/`, `src/app/review/`, `src/app/error.tsx`, `src/app/global-error.tsx` |

## Owner's rules for this app

- **The catalog is the single source of truth.** An app not in `PROJECTS` does not exist. Never delete a catalog entry to hide an app — that is what silently killed the old Cookbook Genie card; move it instead.
- **Moving an app off the hub is one edit in `src/lib/studio/plugins.ts`:** `PLUGIN_SLUGS` (a card on Jarvis › App plugins that opens the app in its own tab), `TOOLBOX_SLUGS` (a tab inside Jarvis › Toolbox, wired in `NewJarvis.tsx`), `WIDGET_SLUGS` (Dashboard widget only). A slug dropped from every list gets its hub tile back — so the two places can never show the same app twice.
- **Merging an app into a studio home:** add `slug → home` to `MERGED_INTO`, add a section in `src/lib/studio-home/<home>.ts`, mount its component `embedded`, and turn its old page into a `redirect()` to `?section=`. If the old path holds the owner's uncommitted PC work (EA World, EA Lab), redirect from `next.config.mjs` instead — never create `src/app/apps/ea-world/page.tsx` or anything under `src/app/apps/ea-lab/`.
- **Private apps holding the owner's data go in `UNPREVIEWABLE`** so the carousel never frames them.
- **V1 must stay untouched.** V2 is a second view of the same catalog with its own stylesheet; nothing in V2 may reach into V1's markup or `globals.css` classes (`HubShell.tsx`, `hub-v2.css` headers).
- **Only one heavy preview at a time** — the front panel, after it settles. Do not mount iframes on other panels.
- **Fail closed:** with `HUB_OWNER_EMAILS` unset nobody is the owner. Token-exempt API paths are exact matches, never prefixes; APIs get JSON 401/403, never a redirect to HTML.
- **Apps must work with no keys set** — a missing key degrades visibly, never 500s (login's "no accounts" mode, AI panel's offline state).
- **Never a white page:** every crash shows the plain-English crash screen and is logged (build checklist R1–R3).
- The legal pages must stay publicly reachable — TikTok and Meta check them before approving a developer app.
- Every app edit lands in Projects Timeline: after committing, run `npm run timeline:log` and commit `src/lib/timeline/feature-log.json`; commit subjects read "<App>: <what changed>".
- Dense, database-style UIs over card grids; every new UI gets a design skill first (`interactive-web-studio` by default).

## Described but not found in code

- **Starring apps** — the Favorites page says "Star projects from their detail page to pin them here", but `/p/<slug>` has no star button and nothing stores favorites (`src/app/favorites/page.tsx`).
- **The hub as a public portfolio** — `PRODUCT.md` says visitors "see the front page and the public apps", but `src/middleware.ts` makes `/` owner-only whenever Supabase is configured; a non-owner is sent to Friends Night Out.
- **A site-wide password gate** — `PRODUCT.md` describes the deployment as "behind an app-level password gate (`appGate.ts` + middleware)"; `APP_GATES` holds only Projects Timeline. The site-wide gate is the Google sign-in + owner-email check.
- **Dashboard gating itself in `src/app/apps/dashboard/page.tsx`** — stated in `src/lib/appGate.ts`'s header; that page is now a redirect, and the password check lives in `src/app/apps/jarvis/page.tsx` (→ `/recall-unlock`).
- **Live settings page** — `/settings` says "Local demo mode" and "Heuristic (no key set)" for everyone; these are fixed strings, not the real storage/AI state (the real AI settings are in the AI pill).
- Code comments in `CarouselHub.tsx` / `PanelFace.tsx` speak of "twenty-seven panels"; the hub currently has 8. The root layout's page title is still "Projects Timeline · Ultimate Assistant OS", so `/` shows that title in the browser tab.

# iPhone Notes

`/apps/iphone-notes` · AI · live · shows as: Dashboard widget — the **Notes half of the one "iPhone" widget** (`src/components/iphone-hub/IphoneWidget.tsx`, widget id `iphone`), shared with Text Inbox

> Your notes, read by Jarvis — you approve every one

An iPhone Shortcut ("Notes to Jarvis") sends the notes you wrote or changed lately, and Jarvis reads each one into
proposals: a to-do, a calendar event, a birthday, something to remember, an app idea for In Queue, a job for the chat
agent, or just keep it in Folders. Every proposal has a confidence score that learns from what you approve — and
nothing runs until you tap Approve.

![iPhone Notes](../../public/look/iphone-notes.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The iPhone widget (shared with Text Inbox)**
- **One widget, two halves** — compact card with a Notes half (waiting count + the two most-sure proposals with score, action and note title) and a Texts half; tapping a half opens the sheet on that side. `src/components/iphone-hub/IphoneWidget.tsx`
- **Status line** — "Notes · N waiting / not linked · Texts … · nothing runs until you approve". `src/components/iphone-hub/IphoneWidget.tsx`
- **Sheet with a Notes / Texts switch** that remembers the last side (`localStorage` `jarvis-iphone:tab`) and mounts `IphoneNotesApp embedded inJarvis`. `src/components/iphone-hub/IphoneWidget.tsx` (`IphoneExpanded`)

**Reading notes**
- **Up to 6 proposals per note**, each one of: To-do, Calendar, Birthday, Remember, In Queue, Do it (chat), Save to Folders, Nothing to do. `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts` (`ACTIONS`, `ACTION_LABEL`, `MAX_ITEMS`)
- **Self-improving confidence score** — the model's own score, calibrated against your past approvals/declines (a kind of guess you keep declining drops); your last decisions also ride along as examples in the next read. `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts`, `src/lib/confidence/calibrate.ts`
- **Why line** — each proposal shows why Jarvis guessed it and how the calibration moved the score. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`
- **Simple mode with no AI key** (or when the call fails / daily cap is spent) — keyword reading, scores kept low, and the page says so. `src/lib/iphone-notes/server/brain.ts`, `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts`
- **No duplicates on re-send** — the same text is a no-op; a re-send with a real title/date/folder fixes those in place without a re-read; an edited note is read again and earlier decisions stay. `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts` (`ingest`)
- **Paste or type a note to try it** — "Read it" runs the same reading without the iPhone. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx` (`PasteNote`)
- **"Not right? Tell Jarvis what this note is"** — re-read a note with your own words. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`, `src/app/api/iphone-notes/route.ts` (`change`)
- **Try again** on a note whose read failed; **Remove** a note from Jarvis. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`, `src/app/api/iphone-notes/route.ts` (`retry`, `remove`)

**Deciding**
- **Approve · <what it will do>** — the button names the action ("Add to your calendar on …", "Save to Folders › iPhone Notes › …"). `src/lib/iphone-notes/client.ts` (`actionLine`)
- **Approve runs first, then records the yes** — a failed save never shows as done or teaches Jarvis. `src/lib/iphone-notes/client.ts` (`runItem`), `IphoneNotesApp.tsx`
- **What each action does** — To-do → Lists "todo" with due date; Calendar → calendar event; Birthday → birthdays store; Remember → `/api/jarvis/memory/save`; In Queue → `/api/new-jarvis/requests`; Do it (chat) → inside Jarvis hands the job to the chat in Do mode (`askJarvis`), outside Jarvis goes to In Queue; Save → Folders › iPhone Notes › <folder>. `src/lib/iphone-notes/client.ts`
- **Edit before approving** — per-action fields (label, text, date, time, location, name, relation, when, folder); approved-after-edit shows "(edited)". `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx` (`EditFields`)
- **Decline** any proposal. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`

**Finding things**
- **Summary panel** — big "N waiting for your yes", what Jarvis has learned ("Learned from N of your decisions…"), last note from your iPhone time, refresh button. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`
- **Confidence Rail** — every waiting proposal is a tick at its score (coloured by band); drag the handle to show only what's at least that sure; tap a tick to jump to its card. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx` (`ConfidenceRail`)
- **Tabs Waiting · Decided · All**, **sort Most sure / Least sure / Newest first**, **search notes**; sort and rail position are remembered (`localStorage` `iphone-notes:view`). `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesApp.tsx`, `src/lib/confidence/calibrate.ts` (`sortByConfidence`)

**iPhone setup**
- **Setup panel** ("iPhone setup" button) — your private push link with **Copy link**, **Test my link**, **New link** (old one stops working), and numbered Shortcut steps (about 5 minutes, no app). `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesSetup.tsx`
- **Last failed run shown with the fix** — what arrived (shape only, `lastFail`) and exactly what to change. `src/components/iphone-notes/IphoneNotesSetup.tsx`, `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts`
- **Push door** `POST/GET /api/iphone-notes/push?k=` — one field `body` = Repeat Item is enough; any field name holding the note is accepted; answers fast and reads after the reply; GET checks the link. `src/app/api/iphone-notes/push/route.ts`
- **Refuses bad pushes with the exact fix** — Shortcut step words typed instead of a variable ("Repeat Item > tap it > Name"), Jarvis's own reply echoed back ("Contents of URL"), many notes glued into one, empty body. `src/lib/iphone-notes/engine.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** Jarvis HUD via interactive-web-studio. Does **not** use DESIGN.md's tokens; own `--ipn-*` set.
- **Colours / type:** canvas `#05060a`, panels `#0c0f17` / `#121623` / `#181d2c`, lines `rgb(120 220 255 / .12–.26)`, ink `#eef3fb` / `#a3adc2` / `#6f7a93`, HUD cyan `#3be3ff`. Confidence bands: high green `#5be38f`, medium cyan `#3be3ff`, low amber `#ffb547`; bad `#ff6b5e`. Own page adds a faint cyan 44px grid + radial glow. Fonts: Oxanium (display) + JetBrains Mono (every number), from `page.tsx` as `--font-nj-display` / `--font-nj-mono`.
- **Layout:** single column, max 980px, on laptop and phone; summary panel collapses to two columns under 640px. Phone first: 16px inputs (no zoom), 40px+ targets. Widget card styles (`.iph-*`) live in `src/components/new-jarvis/deck.css`.
- **Signature pieces:** the Confidence Rail, score rings per proposal (`.ipn-ring[data-band]`), "Approve · <action>" buttons.
- **Motion:** card entry, scan and breathe keyframes; transform/opacity only; all stop under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/iphone-notes/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/iphone-notes/` (`IphoneNotesApp.tsx`, `IphoneNotesSetup.tsx`, `iphone-notes.css`) + widget `src/components/iphone-hub/IphoneWidget.tsx` |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/iphone-notes/` (`engine.ts` + `engine.test.ts`, `client.ts`, `server/brain.ts`, `server/store.ts`); shared calibration `src/lib/confidence/calibrate.ts` (also used by Camera Autopilot, `src/lib/recall/photos/confidence.ts`) |
| API | `src/app/api/iphone-notes/route.ts` (decide, change, retry, add, remove, key.rotate) · `src/app/api/iphone-notes/push/route.ts` (Shortcut door) |

# Item Storm Arena

`/apps/item-storm-arena` · Apps · live · shows as: section of Game Studio (a row in Game Studio › Unfinished games, played there in a frame)

> An interactive gravity playground

A storm of living objects circles a floating arena, and your cursor is a gravity well. Drift near
the storm and it notices you; collect it, then click to launch everything at the kart — coins bank,
crystals shield, paint splashes the arena, an energy shell shatters the headline. Three secret
sequences set off arena-wide events the page never explains, and scrolling moves the world through
four biomes. It is a toy, not yet a game — it lives on the Unfinished games shelf.

![Item Storm Arena](../../public/look/item-storm-arena.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The storm and the cursor**

- **Cursor is a gravity well** — inverse-square pull, scaled by each item's mass; captured items orbit the cursor on a springy lock. `src/components/item-storm-arena/three/ItemStorm.tsx`
- **Eight item kinds with personalities** — capsule (eager, darts in), coin (light, blown by fast-cursor "wind"), crystal (resists, then commits), orb (circles instead of coming straight in), paint bomb (wobbly), energy shell (lunges late), magnet core, gravity orb (heaviest); 60 items total, each its own colour and glow. `src/lib/item-storm-arena/items.ts`, `ItemStorm.tsx`
- **Click to launch the volley at the kart** — items land one by one in the order collected, with impact bursts (showier for coins and orbs). `three/Experience.tsx`, `ItemStorm.tsx`, `three/LaunchFX.tsx`
- **What each hit does** — coin +25 to the bank; crystal raises a shield bubble on the kart (4 s); paint repaints the arena platform (5 s); energy shell shatters the "ITEM STORM ARENA" headline, which springs back; magnet drags the storm (2.4 s); gravity orb flips gravity so the storm floats up (2.8 s). `ItemStorm.tsx`, `src/lib/item-storm-arena/store.ts`, `three/Kart.tsx`, `three/Arena.tsx`, `dom/Hero.tsx`
- **Big volley stunt** — 6+ items in one launch sends the kart into a jump-and-backflip with squash and stretch. `store.ts`, `three/Kart.tsx`
- **Three secret combos** (last three hits, in order, never explained in advance): PRISM BREAK (crystal → coin → orb, galaxy sky 10 s), PAINTED VOID (paint → magnet → gravity, low gravity 8 s), OVERDRIVE (shell → coin → crystal, neon arena 8 s). `src/lib/item-storm-arena/combos.ts`, `three/Sky.tsx` (galaxy), `three/Atmosphere.tsx` + `three/Experience.tsx` (neon + bloom swell), `three/ItemStorm.tsx` (low gravity)

**The world**

- **Four biomes by scroll** — SKY ARENA → CRYSTAL CAVERNS → NEON CITY → DEEP SPACE; sky, fog, lights, accent and star field lerp as you scroll, and scrolling back rewinds it. `src/lib/item-storm-arena/palette.ts`, `three/Sky.tsx`, `three/Atmosphere.tsx`, `three/CameraRig.tsx`
- **Living arena** — waving flags, patrolling cargo drones, a fidgeting kart with breathing glow and exhaust, satellite islands. `three/Arena.tsx`, `three/Kart.tsx`
- **Idle secret** — stay still for 12 s and birds fly past. `three/Arena.tsx`
- **Smooth scroll** — Lenis synced to GSAP ScrollTrigger; one progress number drives the world. `dom/SmoothScrollProvider.tsx`

**The page around it**

- **HUD** — "ITEM STORM / ARENA // 01" plate, ORBIT count, COINS, SECRETS n/3 (hidden on a phone); a toast names a discovered combo; a bottom hint ("drift near the storm — it notices you" → "click to launch everything at the kart") until the 4th hit. Never steals clicks. `dom/Hud.tsx`

# APEX/01 Kart Teardown

`/apps/kart-showcase` · Websites · live · shows as: section of App Builder › Website Redesigner › Showcase (`MERGED_INTO` → `website-redesigner` → `app-builder`; played there in a frame)

> Interactive 3D showcase

A cinematic, interactive 3D racing-kart teardown in the style of a luxury brand site. The kart
turns on a lit stage; hover a section to explode it into labelled parts with names and specs, click
a part to isolate it, then scroll down to drop into a first-person, scroll-driven ride through a neon
tunnel with a live speed and gear readout. It is now a reference piece in Website Redesigner's
Showcase — "app ideas worth building again".

![APEX/01 Kart Teardown](../../public/look/kart-showcase.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Teardown**

- **Kart on a lit stage, slowly orbiting** — the camera circles on its own with pointer parallax, slowing on hover; pushes in on an isolated part. `src/components/kart/CameraController.tsx`, `src/components/kart/Scene.tsx`
- **Hover to explode a region** — Front, Cockpit, Powertrain, Wheels, Aero; that region's parts fly out to their exploded positions. `src/lib/kart/parts.ts` (`REGIONS`), `src/components/kart/Part.tsx`
- **Click to isolate a part** — the rest dim to 10%; click again to release. 12 parts: nose, bumper, seat, steering, engine, exhaust, four wheels, wing, floor. `Part.tsx`, `src/lib/kart/parts.ts` (`PARTS`), `src/components/kart/KartParts.tsx`
- **Leader-line callouts** — name + spec labels at each part's exploded anchor, fading in with a small stagger (igloo.inc technical-annotation look). `src/components/kart/Annotations.tsx`
- **Region readout** HUD for the hovered region. `src/components/kart/Hud.tsx` (`RegionReadout`)

**The scroll story** (scroll phases in `src/lib/kart/store.ts` `PHASE`)

- **Hero** — "EST. 2026 · APEX/01 · RACE-GRADE KART ENGINEERING" with a scroll cue. `Hud.tsx` (`HeroIntro`)
- **Philosophy section** — "Every curve is calculated. Every gram is justified." `Hud.tsx` (`MissionSection`)
- **Founder quote** — with "SCROLL TO DRIVE". `Hud.tsx` (`QuoteSection`)
- **Dive into a first-person ride** — scroll-driven run through tunnel arches with floating spinning kart parts. `src/components/kart/RideScene.tsx`
- **Speed + gear HUD** — km/h and GEAR 1–6 computed from scroll position and speed; "Terminal Velocity · First-person · scroll-driven" title card during the ride. `Hud.tsx` (`SpeedHUD`, `RideTitle`), `RideScene.tsx`
- **Outro** — "YOU JUST DID 180 KM/H · NOW IMAGINE BUILDING IT." with a "START YOUR BUILD" button. `Hud.tsx` (`OutroSection`)
- **Smooth scroll** — Lenis over an 800vh page. `src/components/kart/KartShowcase.tsx`

**Extras and fallbacks**

- **Engine sound toggle** — "Sound: On/Off" in the corner HUD; off by default, WebAudio engine bed whose pitch and grit rise with speed. `src/components/kart/useEngineSound.ts`, `Hud.tsx` (`CornerHUD`)
- **"Assembling kart" loader** with a progress bar. `KartShowcase.tsx`
- **Keyboard / screen-reader access** — hidden buttons "Inspect <region>" and "Isolate <part>: <spec>". `KartShowcase.tsx` (`AccessibleParts`)
- **Reduced motion** — native scroll instead of Lenis, no auto-orbit, label "Reduced-motion mode · calm build". `KartShowcase.tsx`, `CameraController.tsx`
- **No WebGL** — the full teardown as a spec sheet (every part name + spec). `KartShowcase.tsx` (`Fallback`)

**In the Showcase**

- **Listed in Website Redesigner › Showcase** (view `?v=showcase`) — plays in place on the PlayShelf, "Open full screen", and **Use this idea** opens App Builder › Build with the idea box prefilled ("Build an app like APEX/01 Kart Teardown: …"). `src/lib/studio-home/builder.ts` (`SHOWCASE`, hue 16), `src/components/redesigner/Showcase.tsx`

- **Look:** its own luxury motorsport art direction, not DESIGN.md (the redesigner's Showcase calls it "APEX/01"); no design-skill record found.

- **Signature pieces:** the exploding kart with leader-line callouts, mono corner HUD, speed/gear gauge, the neon tunnel ride.

money-agent-studio:
# Money Agent Studio

`/apps/money-agent-studio` · Video · live · shows as: a panel on the Jarvis › Studio wall (spines Clip · Channels · Campaigns). It is in `PLUGIN_SLUGS`, but `studioPlugins()` drops its App plugins card because `onTheWall()` is true. Financial Bible lives inside it as the **Bible** tab.

> Agents that make videos that make money

Standing agents whose only job is income from video: Clippers cut the shareable moments out of long videos, Faceless channels write and voice their own explainers, and Campaign clippers work paid-per-1,000-views clipping campaigns. The owner's PC makes every file, the owner approves every one, Personas Studio posts them, and the money shows in Earnings and in Financial Bible. A Radar tab covers the market side: this week's most lucrative plays, a release calendar, smart companies and a move-alert bot.

![Money Agent Studio](../../public/look/money-agent-studio.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Shell**
- **Seven tabs: Radar · Approve · Pipeline · Agents · Campaigns · Earnings · Bible**. The open tab goes into `?tab=` and is remembered on this device (`money-agent-studio:tab`). `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Smart landing**: if something is waiting for approval, the studio opens on Approve. Otherwise it opens on the last tab used, or on Radar. `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Badges on tabs**: Approve shows how many videos are waiting, and Radar shows today's move-bot catches. `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Header**: a "← App plugins" link back to `/apps/jarvis#plugins`, a subtitle that changes per tab, and a "Financial Bible →" button that switches to the Bible tab. `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Money hero** (on every tab except Radar and Bible): "Paid this month" on a rolling odometer, plus paid all time (gold), estimated from views (mint) and total views. `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Pipeline conveyor**: six stages (Idea → Script → Making → Approve → Sent → Posted) on a lit track. Glowing tokens drift between stages that have work in them. Pressing Approve opens Approve; pressing any other stage filters Pipeline. Stages are defined in `STAGES` in `src/lib/money-agents/types.ts`. `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`
- **Toasts with Undo** (Undo is offered for Skip). `src/components/money-agents/MoneyAgentStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/money-agents/useMoneyAgents.ts`

**Agents**
- **Three kinds of agent**, each started from a "door" card: Clipper, Faceless channel and Campaign clipper (`AGENT_KINDS`). `src/components/money-agents/AgentsTab.tsx`, `src/lib/money-agents/types.ts`
- **Agent ledger table**: agent, kind, posts as, waiting, live, views, estimated, paid. `src/components/money-agents/AgentsTab.tsx`
- **Agent settings**:
  - who it posts as (a Personas Studio persona) and which of that persona's accounts it uses
  - what it clips, or the channel's niche
  - shape (9:16, 16:9 or 1:1) and the shortest and longest length
  - $ per 1K views
  - voice and the rules every clip or video must follow
  - videos per week
  - pause and delete
  `src/components/money-agents/AgentWorkspace.tsx`
- **Campaign fields**: campaign link, who pays, end date, budget, minimum views before it pays, and the content to clip (one link per line). `src/components/money-agents/AgentWorkspace.tsx`
- **"This agent's work" table** with Make and Skip on each row. `src/components/money-agents/AgentWorkspace.tsx`
- **Find clips (Clipper and Campaign agents)**: paste a podcast, stream or long YouTube link, pick how many clips, then press Find moments. The agent's saved sources and campaign links appear as quick-pick chips. `src/components/money-agents/ClipWork.tsx`
- **Four ways to find moments**, tried best first:
  1. a transcript the owner pasted, or the video's own YouTube captions (`server/transcript.ts`), read by AI
  2. the offline keyword finder when no AI key is set
  3. the AI watching the video by its link (`video_url`)
  4. a plain-English request to paste the transcript

  Each result is labelled with how it was picked. `src/app/api/money-agents/moments/route.ts`, `src/lib/money-agents/server/transcript.ts`, `findMoments` in `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`
- **"Or paste the transcript" box**, which opens by itself when the video's words can't be read. `src/components/money-agents/ClipWork.tsx`
- **Moment list**: timestamps, hook, why it works, a quote and a 0–100 score, with a tick box on each. Buttons: Make N on my PC, Keep for later, Discard. `src/components/money-agents/ClipWork.tsx`
- **Faceless ideas**: Get ideas pitches topics for the niche. It is told what the agent already made and how many views those got. Buttons: Keep N, Discard. Shows the "Aiming for N a week" target. With no AI key it uses offline `starterIdeas`. `src/components/money-agents/FacelessWork.tsx`, `src/app/api/money-agents/faceless/route.ts`
- **Script writer**: Write script / Rewrite gives an editable hook, numbered lines each with what is "On screen", a last line, thumbnail words and a caption. Make is locked until a script exists. `src/components/money-agents/FacelessWork.tsx`, `src/app/api/money-agents/faceless/route.ts`

**Make on the PC**
- **Make = one In Queue request per item** in folder `app:money-agent-studio`, built by `clipBrief` or `videoBrief`. Briefs use these skills: link-to-video, embedded-captions, ffmpeg, faceless-explainer. Each brief is at most 4,000 characters and ends with "never post it anywhere". `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`, `src/lib/money-agents/useMoneyAgents.ts`
- **Finished videos move to Approve by themselves** (`arrivedFromPc`). "Being made on your PC" shows each item as waiting, making, finished without a video, or left the queue, with a **Send again** button. `src/components/money-agents/ApproveTab.tsx`, `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`

**Approve (the owner's gate)**
- **Approve card**: plays the video, shows agent and score, and lets the owner edit the caption and hashtags. Pick Post as (persona), tick the accounts, and set When (leave it empty to post by hand from Personas Studio). Buttons: Approve, Skip, Download. `src/components/money-agents/ApproveTab.tsx`
- **Approve hands the video to Personas Studio**: the video is copied into Personas Studio's media folder (`/api/money-agents/handoff`), and a Ready or Scheduled draft is added to the chosen persona with a `draftId`. Personas Studio's own posting queue does the posting. `src/app/api/money-agents/handoff/route.ts`, `draftFor` in `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`
- **Campaign reminder**: "after it posts, submit the post link on the campaign page". There is also a note that links to set up a persona when none exists. `src/components/money-agents/ApproveTab.tsx`

**Pipeline, Campaigns, Earnings**
- **Pipeline table**: every item, newest first. Filter chips by stage (including Skipped), an agent filter, and multi-select with Make / Skip / Clear. Views can be typed by hand. `src/components/money-agents/PipelineTab.tsx`
- **Posted by itself**: an approved item becomes Posted once Personas Studio has its post (`wentLive`). Views come from Personas posts matched by `draftId`, otherwise from views typed by hand (`itemViews`). `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`
- **Find paid clipping campaigns**: an optional niche, then a web search (DuckDuckGo) that AI filters down to real campaign pages showing a rate per 1K. Every raw search result is kept too. Buttons: Add, and "Already joined one? Paste its link". The app never signs up for anything. `src/components/money-agents/CampaignsTab.tsx`, `src/app/api/money-agents/campaigns/route.ts`
- **Earnings**: a 30-day paid chart, a By agent table (paid in gold next to estimated in mint), a "Log money that came in" form (agent, amount, date, source: campaign / YouTube / TikTok / sponsor / other, note), and a Payouts list with remove. `src/components/money-agents/EarningsTab.tsx`
- **Estimates are never stored**: views × the agent's rate per 1K, and zero below a campaign's minimum views. `estimate` in `src/lib/money-agents/logic.ts`

**Radar (market side)**
- **Radar dish**: every play is a blip. Its sector is its kind (IPO, CPI/Fed, Gold & metals, Crypto, Stocks, Dividends, Gov & adoption); the nearer the centre, the stronger the play. A sweep lights each blip. Hovering or tapping a blip lights its row. `src/components/money-agents/RadarTab.tsx`
- **Plays feed**: this week's news (Google News, with DuckDuckGo as fallback) read by AI. For each play it gives why it could pay, how it loses, how you'd get in, and timing (early or late, judged from the last month's price run). Has kind chips, ☆ Star and "+ Bot". With no AI key, a keyword scorer is used. The feed is cached for 20 minutes. `src/app/api/money-agents/radar/feed/route.ts`, `src/lib/money-agents/radar.ts`
- **"Build a bot for this"**: files a paper-only backtest request to Trading Studio (In Queue `app:trading-studio`, `botBrief`). `src/components/money-agents/RadarTab.tsx`
- **Next big release / Happening now** box and a **release calendar** of CPI, jobs and Fed dates for the next four months, with countdowns and the markets each one moves. `src/components/money-agents/RadarTab.tsx`, `src/lib/money-agents/radarSeed.ts`
- **Live price tape** (Gold, Silver, S&P 500, Nasdaq, BTC, XRP, ETH, US Dollar). Prices come from Yahoo, then Stooq or CoinGecko, with no key needed. `src/components/money-agents/RadarTab.tsx`, `src/app/api/money-agents/radar/quotes/route.ts`
- **Smart companies** in three buckets: Profit machines, Dividend payers and Growth bets. You can add or remove tickers. `src/components/money-agents/RadarTab.tsx`, `BUCKETS` in `src/lib/money-agents/radar.ts`
- **Move bot**:
  - polls every 60 seconds while the studio is open, on any tab
  - each market has a rule: alert on a daily move %, alert above or below a price level, and a tighter threshold for 2 hours after a CPI, jobs or Fed release; each rule has an on/off switch
  - browser notifications, with an "Alerts on" control
  - a catches table, scored as paper trades ("if you'd followed its catches…"), with Clear

## How it looks

- **Look:** "a money terminal, not a dashboard of cards". The design skill was interactive-web-studio. The conveyor is the one toy on the Approve, Pipeline, Agents, Campaigns and Earnings tabs; on Radar the radar dish takes its place. Everything else is a dense ledger.   - Canvas and panels: canvas `#06080a`, panels `#0c1013` / `#11171b`, lines `#1b2329` / `#26313a`.
  - Ink: `#e8efea` / `#9caaa4` / `#66746e`.

  - The Bible tab bleeds to full width.
- **Signature pieces:**
  - the odometer (digit reels that roll to the value)
  - the conveyor with drifting mint and gold tokens
  - the radar dish with its sweep and blips
  - the three agent "doors"
  - mint/gold stat tiles and score chips
- **Motion:**
  - `mas-drift` tokens, odometer reels, a springy hover on the stage dots
  - radar sweep, blip pings and the pulse dot

# Personas Studio

`/apps/personas-studio` · AI · live · shows as: Studio wall panel in Jarvis › Studio (spines Personas · Calendar · Analytics) + the Personas pane in Jarvis › Dashboard

> Run every creator persona — ideas, auto-posting, analytics

A content studio for someone running several creator personas at once (a rap channel, an explainer
page, a baby-growth diary). Each persona holds its profile, voice and social accounts; it gets fresh
post ideas every day, a calendar that posts for you through the official APIs, a message inbox, and
analytics that learn what actually works. It is "where the content goes out": every Studio workflow
makes a video, and this is where it meets the persona and account it belongs to — planned at the hour
that persona's own numbers say works, posted for you, then watched view by view so the next
morning's ideas start from what landed. Works offline with template ideas when no AI key is set.

![Personas Studio](../../public/look/personas-studio.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Studio home and personas**
- **Studio home** — totals strip (personas, followers, views 7 days, scheduled + posted this week), one dense table row per persona (accounts, followers, views 7d, 14-day sparkline, next post, ideas waiting), and "Up next, all personas" (soonest 8 scheduled posts). `src/components/social-personas/StudioHome.tsx`
- **Grouped by nickname** — personas are filed under the job they do ("Trolling agent"); the table groups rows under each nickname with its persona count and proven-rule count. `src/lib/social-personas/store.ts` (`nicknameGroups`)
- **New / edit persona** — name, nickname, @username (suggested), profile picture (upload or https URL), niche, profile overview, content types, audience, tone, goals, "Never suggest"; "Start from" presets fill niche/types/audience/tone. `src/components/social-personas/PersonaForm.tsx`, presets `src/lib/social-personas/types.ts` (`PRESETS`)
- **Shipped personas** — the board opens with Barry (six weeks of seeded history for the learning loop) and Daily Dancer (no invented history). `src/lib/social-personas/seed.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/daily-dancer.ts`
- **Deletion sticks** — deleting a shipped persona records it in `dismissed` so seeding never brings it back; deleting also disconnects its accounts and unschedules its drafts. `src/lib/social-personas/store.ts` (`removePersona`), `src/components/social-personas/SocialPersonas.tsx`
- **Persona workspace** — header band in the persona's own hue with avatar, @username, niche, followers / views 7d / scheduled; ten tabs: Overview · Message inbox · Ideas · Plan & post · Analytics · Learning · Character · Videos · Brainstorm · AI memory. Unread badge on Inbox, red dot on Plan when a post failed. `src/components/social-personas/Workspace.tsx`
- **Overview** — profile overview, content-type chips, Niche/Audience/Voice/Goals/Never rows, and a 5-step setup checklist with progress bar (overview → accounts → sign-ins → connect → first post). `src/components/social-personas/OverviewTab.tsx`
- **AI on / off badge** — header shows "AI on" or "AI off — offline ideas". `src/components/social-personas/SocialPersonas.tsx`

**Accounts, sign-ins and Connect**
- **Accounts per persona** — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X, each with username and its own sign-in (login email/phone, password, 2FA, recovery notes). Sign-ins are Recall credentials in folder Personas Studio › <persona>, sealed by the vault (also visible in Jarvis › Passwords); passwords never go in the persona blob; copy-password clears the clipboard after 30 s. `src/components/social-personas/Accounts.tsx`
- **One-login Connect** — one platform login asks for sync + auto-post + inbox scopes; the callback silently retries without inbox, then without posting, if the developer app lacks them, and the account says what is still waiting (`canPost`, `canInbox`). "Reconnect to allow posting", "Sync posts now", remove account. `src/app/api/social-personas/oauth/[platform]/callback/route.ts`, `src/components/social-personas/Accounts.tsx`
- **Official connectors** — TikTok Login Kit + Display API, Instagram API with Instagram Login, Facebook Pages (Graph API), YouTube via Google sign-in. Tokens stay server-side (server_docs `social-personas-conn:<connectionId>`). YouTube syncs + gets comments but never auto-posts (`canAutoPost` = TikTok/Instagram/Facebook only). `src/lib/social-personas/server/connectors.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/types.ts`
- **Connect setup** — "Connections" button (green dots per ready platform) opens a 3-step guide per platform with every value one tap to copy, a link on every step and an official-docs link; the two keys are pasted in-app and saved server-side (no env vars, no redeploy; env vars still win; bad pastes caught). Pressing Connect on an unconfigured platform opens this guide instead of an error. `src/components/social-personas/ConnectSetup.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/server/platformKeys.ts`, `src/app/api/social-personas/setup/route.ts`
- **Auto-sync** — connected accounts older than 3 h re-sync quietly on open; every sync records stat snapshots and a daily follower point (the per-video growth history). `src/components/social-personas/SocialPersonas.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/studio.ts` (`withFollowerPoint`)

**Ideas, brainstorm, memory**
- **Daily ideas** — a new day's batch of 5 is made by itself the first time Ideas opens that day; day picker for past days; Save / Made it / Skip; copy; "5 more ideas" with an optional steer; "Plan it" turns an idea into a draft; "Develop in Brainstorm". Offline template ideas with no AI key. `src/components/social-personas/tabs.tsx` (`TodayTab`), `src/app/api/social-personas/ideas/route.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/logic.ts`
- **Hard limits kept visible** — ideas that break a hard rule (engagement-bait wording Facebook demotes, tragedy, politics, fake news, sexual content…) are held back with their reason shown, never silently dropped. `src/lib/social-personas/formats.ts` (`HARD_AVOID`), `src/lib/social-personas/logic.ts`
- **Brainstorm** — niche-aware chat with the persona's creative producer; clear conversation. `src/components/social-personas/tabs.tsx` (`BrainstormTab`), `src/app/api/social-personas/chat/route.ts`
- **AI memory** — "what the AI knows": summary, voice, content pillars, what works, untapped angles; Rebuild, with a "N new since" stale hint. `src/components/social-personas/tabs.tsx` (`BrainTab`), `src/app/api/social-personas/brain/route.ts`
- **Videos** — add a post by link (AI watches TikTok/YouTube video or reads the caption; paste caption for IG/FB), search posts, "watched" badge, "Read N unread" (10 at a time), open/remove. `src/components/social-personas/tabs.tsx` (`ContentTab`), `src/app/api/social-personas/analyze/route.ts`

**Plan & post**
- **Week calendar** — rolling week you drag posts onto; a drop lands at the persona's best hour (6 PM until stats say better) and springs into place; days tinted by how that weekday performs; on a phone, tap a post to pick its time. Unscheduled tray ("Not scheduled yet · drag onto a day"), New post. `src/components/social-personas/PlanTab.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/studio.ts` (`scheduleOnDay`)
- **Pipeline view** — switchable Calendar / Pipeline: Idea → Script → Film → Edit → Ready → Scheduled → Posted. `src/components/social-personas/PlanTab.tsx` (`Pipeline`)
- **Post editor** — title, hook, caption, hashtags, outline/shot list, per-platform caption-limit counters, video/photo upload, Post to (accounts), Next best slot, Unschedule, Save & schedule, Post now, post-link field that ties it into Analytics; every field saves as you type. `src/components/social-personas/DraftEditor.tsx`, upload `src/app/api/social-personas/media/route.ts` (bucket `social-personas-media`)
- **Reminders for no-API platforms** — accounts that can't auto-post get "Copy caption & open the app" at the time. `src/components/social-personas/DraftEditor.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/types.ts` (`UPLOAD_URL`)
- **Auto-posting queue** — one job per draft+account (never posts twice), locks, backoff, plain-English failures; Instagram reels/photos, Facebook Page video/photo/text, TikTok upload-to-inbox (Direct Post is private-only until TikTok audits the app). `src/lib/social-personas/queue.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/server/queue.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/server/publish.ts`, `src/components/social-personas/schedule.ts`
- **Heartbeat** — `/api/social-personas/publish/tick` driven by `.github/workflows/personas-tick.yml` every 15 min (optional `PERSONAS_TICK_TOKEN`, session-exempt in `src/middleware.ts`) and by the open page, which polls every minute and folds job results back into drafts (lost jobs are re-created). `src/app/api/social-personas/publish/tick/route.ts`, `src/components/social-personas/SocialPersonas.tsx`

**Analytics and learning**
- **Analytics** — KPIs, views per day (30 days), followers over time, every video with progress sparkline, +24h, likes, engagement and "vs usual" momentum (breakout pulses, ×-median), platform filter, video detail with full curve + every reading + "Plan a follow-up", best-time heatmap, "What's working, by format". `src/components/social-personas/AnalyticsTab.tsx`, `src/components/social-personas/charts.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/studio.ts`
- **Learning loop** — each post scored against the page's own normal per person reached; effects shrunk and ranked by the lower bound of a 90% interval; reserved slots for a lever under test and a never-tried format; versioned, append-only lesson sets with a "what changed" diff; weekly median score chart; "Every lever, ranked" table; re-derives by itself daily / when post count changes; no AI key needed. `src/components/social-personas/Learning.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/learn.ts`, format library `src/lib/social-personas/formats.ts`
- **Character document** — `about-me` per persona, versioned with history ("Load this version"), injected verbatim into every generation ahead of the numbers; each idea records the version that made it; unsaved edits survive a reload. `src/components/social-personas/AboutMe.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/logic.ts`

**Message inbox**
- **Live inbox** — Instagram (DMs + comments), Facebook Pages (Messenger + comments), YouTube (comments): read + reply on the persona's normal Connect login; source chips glow with unread counts and filter; All / DMs / comments / unread views; search; 24-hour DM reply-window check; plain-English errors with a fix button; examples before anything is connected; refreshes every minute and on focus. `src/components/social-personas/InboxTab.tsx`, `src/lib/social-personas/inbox.ts`, `src/lib/social-personas/server/inbox.ts`, `src/app/api/social-personas/inbox/route.ts`, `/inbox/reply/route.ts`
- **Write as <persona>** — drafts a reply in the persona's voice that types itself into the box; a person reads and sends. `src/components/social-personas/InboxTab.tsx`, `src/app/api/social-personas/inbox/suggest/route.ts`
- **Open inbox tiles** — apps with no message API (TikTok, X, Threads, Messenger, LinkedIn, Reddit, Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, Snapchat, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) are tiles the person picks once — never scraped. `src/lib/social-personas/inbox.ts` (`OPEN_APPS`)
- **Messages stay on the device** — threads cached in localStorage; only read-marks and chosen tiles sync (`persona.inbox`). `src/components/social-personas/inboxCache.ts`

**Where else it appears**
- **Jarvis Dashboard pane** — the whole Studio mounted `embedded` as Dashboard › Personas (right after Memory and Profile), with a "Full screen" link. `src/components/new-jarvis/DashboardPanel.tsx`
- **Money Agent Studio hand-off** — approved money-agent videos land as Ready/Scheduled drafts on the chosen persona and post through this queue; Financial Bible › Money Plays reads the board. `src/app/api/money-agents/handoff/route.ts`, `src/components/bible/rooms/PlaysRoom.tsx`
- **Old route** — `/apps/social-personas` redirects here, keeping the query string. `src/app/apps/social-personas/page.tsx`

## How it looks

- **Look:** DESIGN.md's near-black instrument panel, with a per-persona hue. No design-skill record in `.impeccable/surfaces/`.
- **Colours / type:** DESIGN.md tokens unchanged (`--color-canvas #0a0b0f`, `--color-panel #12141c`, `--color-brand #6366f1`, ink tokens; system sans, `tabular-nums` on numbers). Differences: each persona carries `--ps-hue` (header band radial gradient, row left stripe, active-tab underline, unread thread stripe, sent-bubble gradient); the logo mark `.ps-mark` is a conic gradient `#ff0050 → #d62976 → brand → #00cae0`; inbox chips glow in their platform colour (`--src`). Green/amber/red are for machine state only; the Learning tab shows polarity by position against zero, not colour. Charts are hand-drawn SVG, one series in brand colour, no legend (`charts.tsx`). Styles in `src/app/globals.css` (`.ps-*`, "Personas Studio" block).
- **Layout:** laptop — max-w-6xl home with KPI strip + wide table (min 760px, scrolls sideways) + Up next list; workspace = hue band header with a scrolling tab row; calendar 7 columns; Overview two columns (`lg`). Phone — KPI strip 2×2, calendar stacks to one column, pipeline scrolls sideways, tap-to-time instead of drag, "Personas Studio" label hides when a persona is open.
- **Signature pieces:** the dense persona table grouped by nickname, the drag-to-schedule week calendar with heat-tinted days, momentum badges with the pulsing "breakout", the interval-bar lever table, inbox source chips.
- **Motion:** springy and snappy — chips land with an overshoot (`ps-land`), dragged-over days lift, sheets rise (`ps-rise`), sent bubbles spring in (`ps-send`), the AI reply types itself in; only a breakout badge loops (`ps-pulse`). `prefers-reduced-motion` turns all of it off and the AI draft appears instantly.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/personas-studio/page.tsx` (redirect: `src/app/apps/social-personas/page.tsx`) |
| UI | `src/components/social-personas/` (shell `SocialPersonas.tsx` exports `PersonasStudio`) |

| Saved data | synced key `social-personas:v1` (app_state); posting queue server_docs `social-personas-queue:<uid>`; tokens server_docs `social-personas-conn:<id>`; videos in bucket `social-personas-media`; inbox messages localStorage only |

Keys: `TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY/SECRET`, `INSTAGRAM_APP_ID/SECRET`, `FACEBOOK_APP_ID/SECRET`, `YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` (or saved in Connect setup), `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` for video storage, optional `PERSONAS_TICK_TOKEN`.

## Owner's rules for this app

- Folder, lib, API routes and the synced key keep the old **Social Personas** name so saved personas survive — never rename them.
