# Video Studio Arena

`/apps/video-studio-arena` · Video · live · shows as: hub tile

> One prompt, five engines, one finished video

The one place to make a video instead of an app per engine. You describe the video, pick how it gets
made (Remotion, HyperFrames, Unreal Engine, Blender or H3 — or let the AI Director mix them), read and
fix a scene-by-scene plan, then render it. H3 renders on the website's server; the other four render on
the owner's PC through a small "studio runner" program, and every engine says plainly what it is missing.

![Video Studio Arena](../../public/look/video-studio-arena.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**The flow (Prompt → Method → Plan → Preview)**
- **Step bar in the header** — Prompt / Method / Plan / Preview buttons, each unlocked only once the step before it has something in it. `src/components/video-studio/VideoStudio.tsx`
- **Home screen** — "Describe a video. Choose the engine…" hero with a Start a video button and a row of engine names coloured by their real status. `src/components/video-studio/VideoStudio.tsx`
- **Your projects table** — every project and version, newest first, with method, status, last updated, open (click or double-click) and delete. `src/components/video-studio/VideoStudio.tsx`
- **"N/5 ready" button and New video button** in the header. `src/components/video-studio/VideoStudio.tsx`
- **Error banner and busy line** — plain-English error you can dismiss; a "Writing the production plan…" style line while work runs. `src/components/video-studio/VideoStudio.tsx`, `src/components/video-studio/studio.tsx`

**Step 1 · The brief**
- **Big prompt box with four example prompts** you can click to fill it. `src/components/video-studio/Brief.tsx`
- **Optional details** — subject, duration (slider 3–120 s plus a number box up to 300 s), visual style, audience, aspect ratio, narration choice, voice (tone/accent/pace, off when narration is none), music, "Burn in captions" tick box, other creative instructions. `src/components/video-studio/Brief.tsx`, rules in `src/lib/video-studio/brief.ts`
- **Can't go on until the prompt is at least a sentence** ("Describe the video you want in a sentence or two."). `src/lib/video-studio/brief.ts` `briefProblem`

**Step 2 · Choose creation method**
- **Five engine cards, no ranking, no "recommended" badge** — each shows Best for, description, strengths, workflow, where it runs (server or your PC), its skill, output format, and a live status badge. `src/components/video-studio/Methods.tsx`
- **"Use this method" stays clickable even when the engine isn't ready**, so the plan can still be written and read; the card says what is missing. `src/components/video-studio/Methods.tsx`
- **AI Director card** — "Let the director choose": every scene routed to the engine that suits it. `src/components/video-studio/Methods.tsx`, routing rules `src/lib/video-studio/plan.ts` `routeScene`
- **Five engines, each a plugin folder** with card copy (`meta.ts`), its skill + engine-specific rewrite prompt (`skill.ts`) and a real machine check (`server.ts`): Remotion → `remotion-best-practices`, HyperFrames → `hyperframes`, Unreal Engine → `unreal-cinematics`, Blender → `blender-studio`, H3 → `h3-scroll-world`. `src/lib/video-studio/methods/<id>/`, list in `src/lib/video-studio/registry.ts`

**Step 3 · Production plan**
- **Engine-agnostic plan written by AI** in the owner's language, with an offline planner as fallback that says so in a note ("written offline"). `src/lib/video-studio/server/plan.ts` `buildPlan`, `src/lib/video-studio/plan.ts` `heuristicPlan`
- **Every field editable** — project title, logline, each scene's title, end second, description and narration; remove a scene or "Add a scene". `src/components/video-studio/Plan.tsx`
- **Per-scene engine picker in AI Director mode** (override the director's choice). `src/components/video-studio/Plan.tsx`
- **"How it will be made" panel** — selected method, skill, and (Director) the engines in this plan; tells you each scene is rewritten in the engine's own terms before rendering. `src/components/video-studio/Plan.tsx`
- **Engine directive per scene** — the rewritten instruction shown under a fold once written. `src/components/video-studio/Plan.tsx`, rewrite in `src/lib/video-studio/server/plan.ts` `optimisePlan`
- **Save without rendering** and **Create Video** (nothing renders until pressed). `src/components/video-studio/Plan.tsx`, `src/components/video-studio/studio.tsx`
- **Render refused up front if an engine isn't ready**, with the reason on screen. `src/lib/video-studio/server/run.ts` `startRender`

**Step 4 · Preview / workspace**
- **Video player** sized to the project's aspect ratio; shows the first finished scene until the whole video exists. `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`
- **Render again, Edit plan, Edit prompt, change-method dropdown, Export (download MP4)**. `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`
- **Render status list** — the real state of every step (○ ⟳ ✓ ✕ –), written by the server loop or the PC runner, never a fake progress bar. `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`, `src/lib/video-studio/server/run.ts`
- **Scenes panel** — Regenerate one scene without redoing the rest, Download clip per scene, attempt count, per-scene error. `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`, API `src/app/api/video-studio/projects/[id]/route.ts` (`render-scene`)
- **Method comparison** — "Try this plan with:" any other engine or AI Director makes a copy (Version A, B, C…); click a version chip to play it side by side, double-click to open it. "No scores, no winner." `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`, `src/lib/video-studio/server/store.ts` `duplicateProject`
- **Production record** — prompt, skill used, companion skills it routes to, created/updated. `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`
- **Generation history** — every brief edit, method change, duplicate and render, newest first (last 100 kept). `src/components/video-studio/Workspace.tsx`
- **Live polling** — an open, rendering project is re-read every 3 s (this also drives server-side H3 renders); engine status re-checked every 20 s. `src/components/video-studio/studio.tsx`

**Rendering**
- **H3 renders on the server** using the hub's video stack: own H3 on RunPod, then MiniMax hosted, then AI Gateway, then an animatic placeholder (which it says plainly). Each shot chains off the previous scene's last frame. `src/lib/video-studio/methods/h3/server.ts`, `src/lib/video-studio/server/run.ts` `lastFrameOf`
- **Remotion, HyperFrames, Unreal, Blender render on the PC** — jobs are queued; the runner claims one, runs Claude Code with that engine's skill, and uploads each scene clip as it finishes. `src/lib/video-studio/server/run.ts` `jobPayload`, `tools/video-studio-runner/runner.mjs`, routes `src/app/api/video-studio/runner/`
- **Assembly** — scenes joined into one MP4 with ffmpeg (concat filter, works across engines in Director mode); without ffmpeg the scenes stay individual and the status line says why. `src/lib/video-studio/server/run.ts` `assemble`
- **Big uploads** — signed Supabase Storage link on the deployed hub, 8 MB chunks locally, up to 1 GB. `src/lib/video-studio/server/store.ts`, `src/app/api/video-studio/runner/clip/route.ts`

**Integrations page ("N/5 ready")**
- **Connect your PC** — runner online/offline/no-token badge, last seen, "Create a runner token" (shown once, Copy button), three setup steps, Re-check. `src/components/video-studio/Integrations.tsx`, `src/app/api/video-studio/runner-token/route.ts`
- **Per-engine requirements table** — each requirement ✓ / ✕ / – optional with what it is and how to get it (runner, installs, MCPs, skills, keys, GPU, ffmpeg), plus a docs link. `src/components/video-studio/Integrations.tsx`, probes `src/lib/video-studio/server/detect.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** "a dark production studio" — its own scoped palette under `.vsa`, not DESIGN.md's tokens. Design skill not recorded (no `.impeccable/surfaces` file for it).
- **Colours / type:** background `#08080b` with a violet glow top-right (`rgba(139,92,246,.14)`) and a faint sky-blue glow top-left; panels `#101017` / `#16161f`; lines `#24242f` / `#32323f`; ink `#eceaf4` / `#9a99a8` / `#6a6a78`; brand violet `#8b5cf6` / `#c084fc`; status green `#4ade80`, amber `#fbbf24`, red `#f87171`. Base text 13px; body font is the hub's sans (`--font-sans`); skills, keys, times and code in a mono stack (`ui-monospace`, JetBrains Mono…). All in `src/components/video-studio/video-studio.css`.
- **Layout:** laptop — sticky frosted header (brand "VIDEO STUDIO ARENA", tag line, step bar, ready/New video), engine cards in an auto-fill grid (min 330px), workspace panels auto-fit (min 340px), two players side by side when comparing. Phone (≤860px) — tag line hidden, step bar drops to its own full-width row, everything one column, requirement tables stack.
- **Signature pieces:** `MethodMark` (a two-hue conic-gradient tile per engine, `src/components/video-studio/ui.tsx`), `CapabilityBadge` status pills, the ○⟳✓✕ render status list, version chips.
- **Motion:** essentially none — no keyframes or transitions in the stylesheet; glass only on the header. `prefers-reduced-motion` turns any animation/transition off anyway.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/video-studio-arena/page.tsx` |
| UI | `src/components/video-studio/` (shell `VideoStudio.tsx`, state hook `studio.tsx`) |
| Logic + tests | `src/lib/video-studio/` (engines `methods/<id>/`, registry `registry.ts` + `server/registry.ts`, test `plan.test.ts`) |
| API | `src/app/api/video-studio/` (`methods`, `plan`, `projects`, `projects/[id]`, `projects/[id]/video`, `runner/{claim,clip,progress,fail}`, `runner-token`) |
| PC runner | `tools/video-studio-runner/` (`npm run runner`, `runner:once`, `start-runner.cmd`; env `HUB_URL`, `HUB_TOKEN`, `VIDEO_STUDIO_WORK_DIR`, `RUNNER_MODEL`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) |
| Saved data | server doc `video-studio` (projects, job queue, hashed runner tokens, per account) via `docStore` in `src/lib/video-studio/server/store.ts`; clips/videos in Storage bucket `video-studio` (local disk when no Supabase). Not `app_state`. |

Env keys read: `RUNPOD_API_KEY` + `RUNPOD_ENDPOINT_ID`, `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (H3 + plan writing), `VIDEO_STUDIO_MODEL` / `AI_MODEL`, `HYPERFRAMES_API_KEY` (optional), `MESHY_API_KEY` (optional), `BLENDER_PATH`, `BLENDER_MCP_PORT`, `UNREAL_ENGINE_DIR`, `FFMPEG_PATH`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_PATH`, `VIDEO_STUDIO_DATA_DIR`.

## Owner's rules for this app

- **Never report an engine "ready" optimistically.** `detect()` must look at the machine; a green tick over a missing install is the failure (`src/lib/video-studio/methods/README.md`).
- **Honesty in the runner:** a missing engine, MCP or key is reported by name and the job fails — no swapping engines, no placeholder passed off as the video; a session that writes no video is a failure (`tools/video-studio-runner/README.md`). The H3 animatic placeholder is allowed only because it is labelled as one.
- **No ranking of engines** — no "recommended" badge, no scores or winner in the comparison.
- **The plan is in the owner's words**; engine-specific wording only ever appears as the rewritten directive.

Two caveats: joining scenes into one file needs ffmpeg on the server (without it you get separate scene clips), and the workspace's "Edit prompt" opens the brief screen but the browser never calls the server's `saveBrief` (`src/lib/video-studio/client.ts`), so an edited brief is not saved onto an existing project.

# Viral Studio Content

`/apps/viral-studio-content` · Video · live · shows as: App plugins card

> Paste it, hover it, keep it

Four boards for the clips worth saving: Viral audio (sounds and songs), Fights, Dances and Motion (surfing, hoops, rap performances, anything that moves). The owner pastes a link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook or anywhere else, and it lands in the open tab, newest first. Hover a tile and it plays. The clips are real reference footage for video workflows. It replaced Dance Vault, and `/apps/tiktok-dances` redirects here (`?tab=dances`).

![Viral Studio Content](../../public/look/viral-studio-content.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Boards and getting clips in**
- **Four tabs**: Viral audio · Fights · Dances · Motion, each with its own hint line and clip count. A sliding segmented switcher sits in the top bar. On a phone it shows short labels. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/viral-studio/types.ts` (`TABS`)
- **Tab in the link**: the open tab is kept in `?tab=` and read back on load. Keys 1–4 switch tabs. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **Paste box** ("Paste a TikTok, Reel, Short or post link"). It accepts several links at once, and its button reads "Add to <tab>". `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/viral-studio/board.ts` (`extractLinks`)
- **Ctrl/⌘+V anywhere** on the page (outside a text box) adds the pasted link(s). `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **Drag a link onto the board**. A full-page "Drop to add to <tab>" overlay shows while dragging. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **No duplicates per tab**: a link already in the tab is not added again. The existing tile flashes and scrolls into view, and the toast says "Already in <tab>". This includes short links that resolve to the same video. `src/lib/viral-studio/board.ts` (`findDuplicate`, `linkKey`, `clipKey`)
- **Newest first** ordering. The newest clip goes large (2×2, 2-wide or normal), sized so the wall plus the add tile ends on a full row. `src/lib/viral-studio/board.ts` (`addClip`, `leadSize`)
- **"Getting the video…" tile** for each link still resolving, with × to cancel it. `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx` (`PendingTile`)
- **"Add a link to <tab>" tile** at the end of the wall. Clicking it focuses the paste box. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **Works offline**: if the server can't be reached, the link is still kept, as an embed-only tile with a note. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/viral-studio/board.ts` (`offlinePlayback`)
- **Empty states**: "Nothing in <tab> yet" with "Paste your first link", and "No clips match those filters" with "Clear filters". `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`

**Playing and deleting**
- **Hover to play**: after a 60 ms delay (so sweeping the mouse doesn't start every tile), the tile under the pointer plays. On touch, tap to play or stop. Escape stops. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`
- **Saved video file when signed in**: the clip is downloaded once into the owner's private storage, so it plays instantly and survives the post being taken down. Posters are saved too. `src/lib/viral-studio/server/resolveLink.ts`, `src/lib/viral-studio/server/storage.ts`, `src/app/api/viral-studio/add/route.ts`
- **Network player fallback**: when the file can't be saved, the clip plays in YouTube's, TikTok's or Instagram's own embed, and the tile says so in a note. Instagram shows "Tap the clip to play — Instagram asks first". YouTube is never downloaded. `src/lib/viral-studio/playback.ts` (`embedUrl`, `playbackLimit`), `src/lib/viral-studio/types.ts` (`Playback`)
- **Sound toggle per tab** in the top bar. Viral audio starts unmuted and the other tabs start muted. The choice is remembered on the device (localStorage `viral-studio:sound`). Until the page has been clicked once, a "Click once anywhere so clips can play with sound" hint shows. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **One-tap delete with Undo**: × on the tile's corner, or Delete/Backspace on the hovered tile. A toast offers Undo for 6 s. The stored files are freed only after the Undo window closes, or when the tab closes. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/app/api/viral-studio/media/route.ts` (DELETE)
- **Open on <site>** corner button links to the original post. `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`
- **Tile caption**: title, site, @handle, view count, and when it was added ("3h ago"). `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`

**Song finder (Viral audio tab, Shazam-style)**
- **Song under the title**: a released song shows "Artist — Song" under the clip's title (linked to a play page when known). An original sound shows nothing. `src/lib/viral-studio/song.ts` (`judgeSound`, `songFromCredit`, `songLine`), `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`
- **The post's own sound credit first** (tikwm `music_info`, yt-dlp `track`/`artist`), **then AudD fingerprinting** of the audio. AudD is free for about 10 lookups a day, and unlimited with `AUDD_API_TOKEN`. Errors come back in plain English. `src/lib/viral-studio/server/songFinder.ts`, `src/app/api/viral-studio/song/route.ts`
- **Find song button** ("Listening…", "Original sound · check again"). Audio clips with no answer yet are checked quietly one at a time, and this stops when the daily limit is hit. A song found by listening adds the "Song" category unless the tags were set by hand. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`

**Filters and tags (every tab)**
- **Order**: Newest / Hot now. `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts` (`applyFilter`, `heatScore`), `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **Mood** filter (Hype, Funny, Chill, Feel-good, Sad, Romantic, Dark, Motivational, Epic, Satisfying). `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts` (`MOODS`)
- **Popularity** filter: Trending now · Rising · Popular · Classic. It is worked out from views per day since posting, not a raw view count (`heatOf`). A note in the tray explains this. `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts`
- **The tab's own categories**: Type & genre (audio) · Fight style · Dance style · Sport & move (motion). `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts` (`CATEGORIES`)
- **Filter trays show counts** per option. Options with no clips are dimmed. "Clear" resets them, and the count reads "x of y". `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`, `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts` (`optionCounts`)
- **Auto-tags on add**: one AI call tags a batch with mood and category. With no AI key, a keyword guess fills in. `src/lib/viral-studio/server/tagger.ts`, `src/lib/viral-studio/filters.ts` (`guessTags`)
- **Backfill**: clips saved before tags existed are tagged quietly, 20 at a time, and missing TikTok view counts are filled in. `src/app/api/viral-studio/tag/route.ts`, `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx`
- **Edit tags by hand** ("+ Tags" / "Edit" chip opens a Mood + Category sheet). Hand-set tags are marked `byHand`, and the auto-tagger never overwrites them. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx` (`TagSheet`)
- **Chips on each tile**: a heat chip plus up to three mood/category chips. `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx`

**Clips with no video (login-only Facebook/Instagram)**
- **Upload the video** on the tile: pick it from the phone or computer (mp4/mov/webm, up to 500 MB). It goes straight to storage through a signed upload link, shows a progress bar, then plays on the tile. `src/components/viral-studio/ClipTile.tsx` (`StuckFixes`), `src/lib/viral-studio/stuck.ts`, `src/app/api/viral-studio/upload/route.ts`
- **Connect Facebook / Instagram sheet**: steps for the Jarvis Record extension ("Connect Facebook & Instagram"), or on a phone, paste cookies. It watches for the connection, closes itself, and refetches every stuck clip from that site. Only the owner can connect. `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx` (`ConnectSheet`), `/api/social-import/cookies`
- **Try again** on the tile. Stuck clips are also retried quietly once the site has been connected somewhere else (Cook Connect, the extension, another device). `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx` (`retryClip`), `src/lib/viral-studio/stuck.ts` (`retryAfterConnect`, `mergeRetry`)
- **Facebook share links** (`/share/r/…`) are followed to the real reel before downloading. `src/lib/social-import/videoDownload.ts` (shared with other apps)

**Saving**
- **Follows the user between devices**: the board is saved locally and synced to the account under `viral-studio:v1`, and it updates when another device changes it. `src/lib/viral-studio/store.ts`, `src/components/viral-studio/ViralStudio.tsx` (`useRemotePull`)
- **Each account sees only its own files**: every stored key starts with the owner's id, and the media, upload and delete routes refuse anyone else's. `src/lib/viral-studio/server/storage.ts` (`ownsKey`), `src/app/api/viral-studio/media/route.ts`

## How it looks

- **Look:** "Streaming-grade gallery where colour is earned", with an Apple TV+ craft bar. Made with `impeccable` plus `webgl-trail-reveal`. The design record is `.impeccable/surfaces/src-components-viral-studio-viralstudio-tsx.md`. It is deliberately **not** the hub's DESIGN.md (Night Console): the owner chose a separate look for this app.
- **Colours / type:** tokens on `.vsc` in `viral-studio.css`: ground `#000`, raised surfaces `#0e0e10` / `#1c1c1e`, hairlines white 9% / 16%, ink `#f5f5f7` / `#a1a1a6` / `#8b8b91`, warn `#e5b94e`, delete `#ff453a` (delete hover only). White is the only accent and the clips supply all the colour. There is no per-tab colour and no glows. Font: Geist Sans (`geist/font/sans`, passed from `page.tsx`). Display titles 52–92px/700/-0.04em (48px on a phone), body 15–16px, meta 13px. One easing curve, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`. 14px artwork radius and pill buttons.
- **Layout:** laptop: a sticky translucent top bar (back arrow, "Viral Studio" wordmark, the four-segment switcher in the centre, sound on the right). Below it, a hero with the tab name at display size, the hint and count, and the paste box, lit by a blurred copy of the newest clip's poster. Then a filter row that sticks under the bar, and the wall of 3:4 posters: 4 columns above 1180px, 3 above 860px, 2 below. Phone (≤860px): the switcher drops to its own row with short labels, the grid is 2 columns, the lead tile is 4:5, and the keyboard tips are hidden. On touch, the corner buttons are always visible on a dark shade.
- **Signature pieces:** clips rest in **black and white** (grayscale, slightly darkened). On hover, a WebGL trail (24-point ring buffer, thin RGB-split edge) scans colour in where the pointer goes, then floods to full colour as the clip plays (`TrailReveal.tsx`, logic `trail.ts`). Only one WebGL context and one player exist at a time. Real thumbnails come from our own domain via `/api/viral-studio/poster` (YouTube maxres → hq). Letterbox bars and blurred side copies are trimmed off each still in the browser (`contentRegion`, `sharpRegion`). The lifted tile tilts slightly with a sheen that follows the pointer.
- **Motion:** 220ms controls and a 450–500ms lift. The trail takes about 0.8 s to scan and 0.8 s to flood. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, animations and transitions drop to near zero, the lifted tile doesn't tilt, and the sheen is hidden.

## Where the code is

| Part | Path |
|---|---|
| Page | `src/app/apps/viral-studio-content/page.tsx` (+ redirect `src/app/apps/tiktok-dances/page.tsx`) |
| UI | `src/components/viral-studio/` (`ViralStudio.tsx`, `ClipTile.tsx`, `TrailReveal.tsx`, `viral-studio.css`) |

## Owner's rules for this app

- Nothing is seeded. Every clip was put there by the owner. The old Dance Vault board (`dances:v1`, about 200 seeded dances) was **not** carried over: the owner asked for all of them gone (`src/lib/viral-studio/store.ts`).

# Workflow Maker

`/apps/workflow-maker` · Video · live · shows as: App plugins card (in `PLUGIN_SLUGS`, not on the Studio wall) + a Studio card in Jarvis › Studio on the "Special skills" shelf (`WORKFLOWS` in `src/lib/studio/workflows.ts`)

> Show it any process — it builds the working tool

The owner's "rea to workflow". Drop a video or pictures of any process — a way people make money
clipping videos, a creator's routine, a tutorial, a website, game or app you like — and say what
you want. Jarvis watches it and lays out a blueprint you can edit: what it will make (a workflow,
an agent that goes and makes money, an app, a website or a game), every input as an upload slot,
every step with the engine that does it, the result, and the card as it will look. Press **Build it**
and Claude Code on the owner's PC builds the real thing with the `rea-to-workflow` skill.

# YouTube videos

`/apps/youtube-videos` · AI · live · shows as: Dashboard widget (Jarvis › Dashboard, widget id `youtube`; also opens on its own page)

> Paste a video link now, watch it later

A watch-later list for video links from any app: paste a YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo,
Twitch or Reddit link and it lands at the top of the list with its title, channel and thumbnail filled in. For you
suggests what to watch next from what you save. It lives on the Jarvis Dashboard as a widget, and the same app also
runs on its own page.

![YouTube videos](../../public/look/youtube-videos.jpg)

## Features — every one of these must still exist after your change

The owner asked for each of these. Removing, hiding or "simplifying away" one is a regression,
even if the code looked unused. If a change needs one gone, ask first.

**Saving links**
- **Paste box ("command bar")** — paste a link and press Save; it recognises the platform and shows a preview (thumbnail, platform, kind) before you save. `src/components/youtube-videos/YouTubeVideosApp.tsx`
- **Paste anywhere on the page** — pasting while not typing in another box saves at once. `src/components/youtube-videos/YouTubeVideosApp.tsx`
- **Several links at once** — a blob of text with many links (even with no `https://`) saves each one. `src/lib/youtube-videos/links.ts` (`extractUrls`, `parsePaste`)
- **Every platform understood** — YouTube (videos, Shorts, live, `?t=` start time), TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo, Twitch, Reddit, Snapchat, Pinterest; unknown sites still save as "Link". `src/lib/youtube-videos/links.ts`
- **No duplicates** — the same video in any spelling (youtu.be, `?si=` tracking, etc.) gets one dedupe key; re-pasting moves it back to the top. `src/lib/youtube-videos/links.ts`, `src/lib/youtube-videos/library.ts`
- **Newest first** — a fresh save always goes to the top. `src/lib/youtube-videos/library.ts`
- **Titles, channels and thumbnails fill in by themselves** — looked up through each platform's public oEmbed (allowlisted endpoints only; never fails loudly). `src/app/api/youtube-videos/meta/route.ts`, `src/lib/youtube-videos/useLibrary.ts`
- **Plain-English bad-paste message** — "That doesn't look like a link…". `src/components/youtube-videos/YouTubeVideosApp.tsx`
